title: What and Where in Identifying and Quantifying Conventions in Humans and AI Agents

paragraphs.en: Cooperative success rests in part on implicit communication. Partners converge on conventions: regularities that give an action meaning beyond its direct effect. Yet conventions are usually observed only indirectly: a score drop when partners are swapped shows that a convention existed, but not what it was or where it was used. In the card game Hanabi, the exact probability that a play fails can be computed from the hints received and the cards in view. Players who use conventions succeed more often than this prediction allows; the resulting margin is the convention gap. Off-belief learning provides a hierarchy of agents (levels 1–5) whose first level uses no conventions by construction and whose later levels use progressively more. For humans and these agents on one scale, we ask what the conventions are and where they are used. On what: in two independently collected corpora of human games, humans show a larger gap than every agent level. On the conventions both populations use, however, humans do no better than level 2. The human advantage is concentrated in a situation that no agent level learns to use: hints that point to a card other than the ones they touch. On where: conventions depend on what the player already knows about the card, not on how recently it was hinted, and they are used most in the mid-game; humans use them earlier and later in the game than the agents. In interventions on the agents, blocking a single high-gap situation costs little, because meaning reroutes to other situations, but blocking several together costs far more than the sum of the single costs. Thus, the convention gap turns conventions from an inferred cause of score loss into a measurable, comparable, and causally testable object.
paragraphs.zh: 合作的成功部分取决于隐性的沟通。 合作者会形成惯例：这些规律赋予某种行动超越其直接影响的含义。 然而，惯例通常只能被间接观察到：当合作者被替换时得分下降，表明存在某种惯例，但无法说明具体是什么或在哪里使用。 在卡牌游戏《Hanabi》中，一次出牌失败的确切概率可以根据收到的提示和可见的卡牌计算出来。 使用惯例的玩家成功频率高于这一预测所允许的程度；由此产生的差异就是“惯例差距”。 “偏离信念学习”构建了一个由智能体组成的层级（第1至5级）：第一级按设计不使用任何惯例，而后续各级使用的惯例则逐渐增多。 对于人类和这些智能体这两个群体，我们想知道它们使用的惯例是什么以及这些惯例在何处被使用。 就“什么”而言：在两个独立收集的人类游戏语料库中，人类的惯例差距大于所有智能体层级。 然而，在两个群体共同使用的惯例方面，人类的表现并不优于第2级智能体。 人类的优势集中在一种任何智能体层级都未学会利用的情况上：提示指向的卡牌并非他们手中正在操作的卡牌。 就“何处”而言：惯例取决于玩家对卡牌已有的了解，而非提示给出的时间远近，并且主要在游戏中期使用；而人类在游戏早期和晚期都比智能体更多地使用惯例。 在对智能体的干预实验中，阻断单个高差距情况几乎不会造成损失，因为含义会重新导向其他情况；但同时阻断多个情况所造成的损失，远大于各单独损失的总和。 因此，“惯例差距”将惯例从一种被推断出的得分下降原因，转变为一个可测量、可比较且能够进行因果验证的对象。

paragraphs.en: Successful cooperation depends in part on implicit communication. Partners converge on conventions: regularities that give an action a meaning beyond its direct effect ( Lewis, 1969 ) . People and AI agents both rely on conventions alongside the explicit information the rules provide. In zero-shot coordination (ZSC) ( Hu et al., 2020 ; Treutlein et al., 2021 ) , conventions are what break when a policy meets a partner it was not trained with. Yet conventions are usually studied indirectly, through the score an agent loses when its partner is swapped. A score drop shows that a convention existed. It does not say what the convention was, where it operated, what it was worth, or whether humans share it.
paragraphs.zh: 成功的合作部分取决于隐式沟通。 合作者会形成惯例：这些规律赋予某种行为超越其直接影响的含义（Lewis，1969）。 人类和人工智能智能体都依赖惯例，以及规则所提供的显性信息。 在零样本协作（ZSC）中（Hu et al.，2020；Treutlein et al.，2021），当一个策略遇到其未训练过的合作者时，惯例便会失效。 然而，惯例通常通过间接方式研究，即通过智能体在合作者被替换时所损失的分数来推断。 分数的下降表明存在某种惯例。 但这并未说明该惯例的具体内容、作用位置、价值，或人类是否也共享这一惯例。

paragraphs.en: A recent study ( Fukushima et al., 2026 ) proposes a more direct diagnostic in the cooperative card game Hanabi ( Bard et al., 2020 ) . At every play action, a literal observer computes the exact probability that the played card fails, using only information the rules guarantee: the hint constraints on every card in the hand, and card counting over all visible zones. Averaged over many plays, the difference between this predicted failure rate and the actual one is the convention gap ( Fukushima et al., 2026 ) . Off-belief learning (OBL) trains a hierarchy of agents ( Hu et al., 2021 ) . Level 1 is trained to read past actions only for their literal content, and later levels may interpret more. On this hierarchy, the gap rose monotonically with level, from + 1.57 +1.57 to + 21.68 +21.68 percentage points (pp) ( Fukushima et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 最近的一项研究（Fukushima 等人，2026）提出了一种在合作卡牌游戏《Hanabi》（Bard 等人，2020）中更为直接的诊断方法。 在每次行动时，一个字面观察者仅使用规则所保证的信息来计算已出牌失败的确切概率：即手牌中每张牌的提示约束，以及对所有可见区域中卡牌的计数。 在多次游戏过程中取平均值后，该预测失败率与实际失败率之间的差异即为惯例差距（Fukushima 等人，2026）。 非信念学习（OBL）用于训练一个智能体层级结构（Hu 等人，2021）。 第 1 层仅被训练为读取过往行动的字面内容，而后续层级则可能进行更深入的解读。 在该层级结构中，该差距随层级升高而单调增加，从 +1.57 到 +21.68 个百分点（pp）（Fukushima 等人，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Here, we identify candidate conventions where plays beat the literal prediction, and quantify that departure in pp. We ask three questions of humans and the OBL hierarchy on one scale. (i) What are the conventions: which situations carry the gap, and to what extent do the two populations agree on them? (ii) Where are they used: when in the game, in which situations, and carried by which feature of the game state? (iii) To what extent does removing a convention cost score, relative to removing an equally frequent play at random? We address them by breaking the gap down by situation and by turn, by placing a public human corpus ( Hanab Live, 2026 ) and a second, independently collected corpus ( Dizdarević et al., 2025 ) on the same scale as the hierarchy, and by intervening on the agents’ policies against a frequency-matched control.
paragraphs.zh: 在此，我们识别出那些博弈行动偏离字面预测的候选惯例，并以 pp 为单位量化这种偏离程度。 我们在同一量表上，对人类和 OBL 层级提出三个问题。 (i) 这些惯例是什么：哪些情境存在这种差距，以及两个群体在这些情境上的共识程度如何？ (ii) 它们被用于何处：在游戏进程的哪个阶段、哪些情境中，又由游戏状态的哪个特征所触发？ (iii) 移除一个惯例会损失多少分数，这与随机移除一个频率相当的博弈行动相比如何？ 我们通过按情境和回合分解这种差距来回答这些问题，具体方法是将公开的人类语料库（Hanab Live, 2026）和第二个独立收集的语料库（Dizdarević et al., 2025）置于与层级相同的量表上，并基于频率匹配的控制组对智能体的策略进行干预。

paragraphs.en: The convention gap of the human corpus, + 26.16 ​ [ + 24.05 , + 28.28 ] ​ pp +26.16~[+24.05,+28.28]\,\text{pp} , is larger than that of every level of the OBL hierarchy, and their profile across play situations replicates on the second corpus ( r = 0.97 r=0.97 ; Appendix E ). On the conventions both populations share, humans are not significantly closer to level 5 than to level 2. The remaining difference lies in one situation where no level approaches the human gap: hints that point to a card other than the one they touch ( indirect reference ; § 3.1 ). The gap peaks in the mid-game, and the human gap exceeds level 5’s in the opening and late game. In the agents, the gap follows what the player already knows about the played card rather than how recently it was hinted (§ 3.2 ). Finally, blocking one high-gap situation in the agents’ play lowers their score little more than blocking an equally frequent play at random, because blocked plays partly reappear in other situations; blocking several situations together costs more than the sum of the single blocks ( − 1.84 -1.84 points jointly against − 0.77 -0.77 summed; § 3.3 ). paragraphs.zh: 人类语料库的惯例差距为 +26.16 [ +24.05 , +28.28 ] pp +26.16~[+24.05,+28.28]\,\text{pp}，大于 OBL 层级中每一级的惯例差距，且其在不同对局情境中的分布模式在第二个语料库中得以重现（r = 0.97；附录 E）。 在两个群体共有的惯例上，人类与第 5 级的接近程度并不显著高于与第 2 级的接近程度。 其余差异体现在一种情境中：没有任何层级能接近人类的惯例差距——即提示指向一张非其接触卡牌的线索（间接指代；§ 3.1）。 该差距在中局达到峰值，而在开局和残局阶段，人类的惯例差距超过了第 5 级的水平。 在智能体中，该差距取决于玩家对已打出卡牌的已有认知，而非提示出现的时间远近（§ 3.2）。 最后，在智能体的对局中阻止一种高差距情境对其得分的影响，略大于随机阻止一个频率相同的情境，因为被阻止的对局行为会部分地出现在其他情境中；同时阻止多个情境所造成的损失，大于各单次阻止损失的总和（联合阻止损失 −1.84 分，而单独阻止的总和为 −0.77 分；§ 3.3）。 综合来看，这些结果表明，一个精确的字面基准如何能够定位并比较人类与智能体之间的惯例差异，并在智能体中对其量化评估。

paragraphs.en: A convention in Lewis’s sense is a self-sustaining regularity that resolves a coordination problem among alternatives ( Lewis, 1969 ) . In cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning such regularities are what self-play policies acquire, and the Hanabi challenge made their cost visible: policies that score well together fail with partners trained separately ( Bard et al., 2020 ) . The ZSC program addresses this by construction. Other-Play removes symmetry-dependent conventions ( Hu et al., 2020 ) ; off-belief learning trains its first level to read past actions only for their literal content and lets later levels interpret more ( Hu et al., 2021 ) ; K-level reasoning, trajectory diversity, and the label-free formalism of Treutlein et al. (2021) give further routes to compatible policies ( Cui et al., 2021 ; Lupu et al., 2021 ) . Evaluation in this line is by cross-play score ( Wolski et al., 2026 ) . This paper proposes no ZSC method; it locates the conventions those methods act on, using the off-belief learning hierarchy.
paragraphs.zh: 在刘易斯的意义上，一种惯例是一种自我维持的规则性，它解决了不同选择之间的协调问题（Lewis, 1969）。 在合作式多智能体强化学习中，这类规则性正是自我博弈策略所获得的成果，而“汉娜比”挑战则揭示了其代价：那些能共同取得高分的策略，在与单独训练的伙伴合作时却会失败（Bard et al., 2020）。 ZSC 项目通过其构建方式解决了这一问题。 “他者博弈”消除了依赖对称性的惯例（Hu et al., 2020）；“离信念学习”则训练其第一层仅根据过往行动的字面内容进行解读，并允许后续层级进行更深入的诠释（Hu et al., 2021）；K 级推理、轨迹多样性以及 Treutlein 等人（2021）提出的无标签形式化方法， 提供了更多获得兼容策略的途径（Cui et al., 2021; Lupu et al., 2021）。 这一方向上的评估通过跨博弈得分进行（Wolski et al., 2026）。 本文并未提出任何 ZSC 方法；它利用“离信念学习”层级结构，定位了这些方法所作用的惯例。

paragraphs.en: Evaluating agents with people is costly, so the field increasingly substitutes behavioral clones of human play. The practice was established in Overcooked ( Carroll et al., 2019 ) ; population-based training aims to remove the need for human data altogether ( Strouse et al., 2021 ) ; in Hanabi, human-team studies ( Siu et al., 2021 ) and the AH2AC2 benchmark, whose proxies are cloned from human games ( Dizdarević et al., 2025 ) , follow the same route. Appendix H tests what such clones preserve at the level of individual conventions.
paragraphs.zh: 用真人来评估智能体成本高昂，因此该领域越来越多地采用人类游戏行为的克隆体作为替代。 这种做法最初确立于《Overcooked》（Carroll 等人，2019）；基于群体的训练方法则旨在完全消除对真人数据的需求（Strouse 等人，2021）；在《Hanabi》中，关于人类团队的研究（Siu 等人，2021）以及 AH2AC2 基准测试——其代理模型均克隆自人类游戏（Dizdarević 等人，2025）——也遵循了同样的路径。 附录 H 检验了此类克隆体在个体惯例层面保留了哪些特征。

paragraphs.en: Shih et al. (2021) separate a policy into a task-specific module and a partner-specific convention module and show that the latter transfers across tasks; Any-Play augments training to discourage conventions ( Lucas and Allen, 2022 ) . Both treat conventions as a hidden variable to be separated out or suppressed. Here plays are compared with an exact literal baseline, so a convention’s location and carrier can be reported without a learned probe.
paragraphs.zh: Shih 等人 (2021) 将策略分为一个任务特定模块和一个伙伴特定惯例模块，并证明后者可以在不同任务间迁移；Any-Play 通过增强训练来抑制惯例（Lucas 和 Allen，2022）。 这两种方法都将惯例视为需要分离或抑制的隐藏变量。 在此，行动与精确的字面基线进行比较，因此无需通过学习探测即可报告惯例的位置和执行者。

paragraphs.en: Hints in Hanabi are speech acts whose intended meaning exceeds their literal content, the situation the rational speech act framework models as recursive inference between speaker and listener ( Frank and Goodman, 2012 ; Goodman and Frank, 2016 ) , building on Gricean implicature and common ground ( Grice, 1975 ; Clark, 1996 ) . The convention gap needs no fitted listener: it compares observed failures with literal predictions, in percentage points of failure.
paragraphs.zh: 《Hanabi》中的提示是言语行为，其意图意义超越了字面内容；理性言语行为框架将这种情况建模为说话者与倾听者之间的递归推理（Frank 和 Goodman，2012；Goodman 和 Frank，2016），并在此基础上发展了格莱斯式言外之意与共同基础理论（Grice，1975；Clark，1996）。 惯例差异不需要适配的倾听者：它通过比较观察到的失败情况与字面预测结果，以失败率的百分点来衡量。

paragraphs.en: Off-belief learning ( Hu et al., 2021 ) trains a policy whose Q Q -targets are computed on fictitious states, resampled from a belief model that assumes all past actions came from a fixed base policy π 0 \pi_{0} . The learner is scored as if the past carried only what π 0 \pi_{0} would put into it. Level 1 uses a uniformly random π 0 \pi_{0} , so it is trained to read past actions only for their literal content ( grounded play). Each later level is trained with beliefs induced by the previous level’s policy, so it may interpret more. Agent levels are written level k k in the text and OBL k k in figures and tables. The released archive holds five seed models per level; the ladder below uses the first of each. Level 5 is in the archive but not among the results published with OBL ( Hu et al., 2021 ) , and every trend claim here holds on levels 1–4 alone. In the previous study ( Fukushima et al., 2026 ) , the gap rose monotonically with level, from + 1.57 ​ [ + 1.33 , + 1.81 ] ​ pp +1.57~[+1.33,+1.81]\,\text{pp} at level 1 to + 21.68 ​ [ + 21.34 , + 22.02 ] ​ pp +21.68~[+21.34,+22.02]\,\text{pp} at level 5. Level-1 cross-play, pooled over all pairings among five independently trained level-1 models, gave + 1.22 ​ [ + 0.98 , + 1.45 ] ​ pp +1.22~[+0.98,+1.45]\,\text{pp} .
paragraphs.zh: 超信念学习（Hu et al., 2021）训练一种策略，其Q目标值基于虚拟状态计算得出；这些状态从信念模型中重新采样，而该模型假设所有过往动作均来自一个固定的基础策略π₀。 学习者的评分基于这样一种假设：过往仅包含π₀会放入其中的信息。 第1级使用均匀随机分布的π₀，因此它被训练为仅根据过往动作的字面内容（具象化博弈）进行解读。 每个后续级别均使用前一级的策略所引发的信念进行训练，因此能够解读更多信息。 文本中智能体级别写作“第k级”，而在图表中则写作“OBLₖ”。 发布的存档包含每个级别的五个初始模型；下方的层级结构使用了每个级别的第一个模型。 第5级存在于存档中，但未包含在随OBL（Hu et al., 2021）一同发表的结果中，且此处所有趋势结论均仅基于第1至第4级成立。 在前一项研究（Fukushima et al., 2026）中，该差距随级别单调上升：从第1级的+1.57~[+1.33, +1.81] pp，增至第5级的+21.68~[+21.34, +22.02] pp。 第1级跨模型博弈（综合五个独立训练的第1级模型之间的所有配对）得出+1.22~[+0.98, +1.45] pp的结果。

sents.en: Each later level is trained with beliefs induced by the previous level’s policy, so it may interpret more.
sents.zh: 每个后续级别均使用前一级的策略所引发的信念进行训练，因此能够解读更多信息。

sents.en: Agent levels are written level k k in the text and OBL k k in figures and tables.
sents.zh: 文本中智能体级别写作“第k级”，而在图表中则写作“OBLₖ”。

sents.en: The released archive holds five seed models per level; the ladder below uses the first of each.
sents.zh: 发布的存档包含每个级别的五个初始模型；下方的层级结构使用了每个级别的第一个模型。

sents.en: Level 5 is in the archive but not among the results published with OBL ( Hu et al., 2021 ) , and every trend claim here holds on levels 1–4 alone.
sents.zh: 第5级存在于存档中，但未包含在随OBL（Hu et al., 2021）一同发表的结果中，且此处所有趋势结论均仅基于第1至第4级成立。

sents.en: In the previous study ( Fukushima et al., 2026 ) , the gap rose monotonically with level, from + 1.57 ​ [ + 1.33 , + 1.81 ] ​ pp +1.57~[+1.33,+1.81]\,\text{pp} at level 1 to + 21.68 ​ [ + 21.34 , + 22.02 ] ​ pp +21.68~[+21.34,+22.02]\,\text{pp} at level 5.
sents.zh: 在前一项研究（Fukushima et al., 2026）中，该差距随级别单调上升：从第1级的+1.57~[+1.33, +1.81] pp，增至第5级的+21.68~[+21.34, +22.02] pp。

sents.en: Level-1 cross-play, pooled over all pairings among five independently trained level-1 models, gave + 1.22 ​ [ + 0.98 , + 1.45 ] ​ pp +1.22~[+0.98,+1.45]\,\text{pp} .
sents.zh: 第1级跨模型博弈（综合五个独立训练的第1级模型之间的所有配对）得出+1.22~[+0.98, +1.45] pp的结果。

paragraphs.en: Unless stated otherwise, agent conditions use 1000 1000 games per condition with distinct environment seeds and greedy acting; the taxonomy below pools five seed models per level ( 5000 5000 games; level 1 uses only the first).
paragraphs.zh: 除非另有说明，智能体条件设置中每个条件使用 1000 1000 局游戏，并采用不同的环境种子和贪心策略；下方的分类体系按每级合并五个种子模型（5000 5000 局游戏；第 1 级仅使用第一个）。

paragraphs.en: People who play Hanabi competitively have conventions too, but theirs are taught : a player community publishes and teaches a convention system ( H-Group, 2026 ) . The human games are public logs from the hanab.live platform ( Hanab Live, 2026 ) , where this community plays. We first establish that these logs and the generated agent games are comparable. First, the same exact joint posterior is applied to both populations; nothing is re-estimated for humans. Second, the human games were replayed through the same extraction pipeline used for the agents and reproduced the reference posteriors bit-identically over all 9017 9017 plays. Third, the corpus and its filters are inherited unchanged from the previous study ( Fukushima et al., 2026 ) : a completed-games filter and a two-tier bot exclusion applied by the same code, giving 425 425 games, 9017 9017 plays and 155 155 players. Pairs recur across games ( 95 95 pairs in all), so every human interval is clustered at the pair level. A second, independently collected corpus, the open games of the AH2AC2 benchmark ( Dizdarević et al., 2025 ) , is processed through the identical pipeline and serves as a replication corpus.
paragraphs.zh: 竞技性《花火》玩家也有自己的规则体系，但他们的规则是明确传授的：一个玩家社群会发布并教授一套规则系统（H-Group，2026）。 人类对局的记录来自 hanab.live 平台的公开日志（Hanab Live，2026），该社群正是在此平台上进行游戏。 我们首先确认这些日志与智能体生成的对局具有可比性。 首先，完全相同的联合后验概率被应用于两个群体；人类玩家的数据没有任何重新估计。 其次，人类对局通过用于智能体的相同提取流程重新处理，并在全部 9017 局游戏中以逐位一致的方式复现了参考后验概率。 第三，该语料库及其筛选规则均直接沿用自先前研究（Fukushima 等，2026）：通过同一套代码应用“已完成游戏”筛选器和双层机器人排除机制，最终得到 425 局游戏、9017 局对局和 155 名玩家。 游戏对在不同游戏中重复出现（共 95 对），因此所有人类玩家的区间都在对级别上进行聚类。 第二个独立收集的语料库——AH2AC2 基准测试中的公开游戏（Dizdarević 等，2025）——也通过完全相同的流程处理，并作为复现语料库使用。

paragraphs.en: Because Δ \Delta is a mean over plays, it can be broken down by situation. Two category systems do this. The first is hand-crafted: five mutually exclusive play situations (played immediately after a partner color hint touched the card; immediately after a rank hint; hinted earlier; unhinted and newest-drawn; unhinted and older). A card is unhinted if no hint has touched it; hints to other cards can still exclude values for it. Table 1 and § 3.2 report the gap by situation. Plays made immediately after a hint touched a different card, indirect reference , are tracked with the finer categories described next.
paragraphs.zh: 由于 Δ \Delta 是对所有出牌次数的平均值，因此可以按不同情况分解。 两个分类系统实现了这一点。 第一个是人工设计的：五种互斥的出牌情况（在搭档的颜色提示接触卡片后立即出牌；在等级提示后立即出牌；之前已提示；未提示且最新抽取的；未提示且较旧的）。 如果没有任何提示接触过某张卡片，则该卡片被视为未提示的；但对其他卡片的提示仍然可能排除该卡片的某些数值。 表 1 和 § 3.2 报告了不同情况下的差距。 在提示接触了另一张卡片后立即进行的出牌（间接引用），将通过下文描述的更精细分类进行追踪。

sents.zh: 由于 Δ \Delta 是对所有出牌次数的平均值，因此可以按不同情况分解。

sents.zh: 如果没有任何提示接触过某张卡片，则该卡片被视为未提示的；但对其他卡片的提示仍然可能排除该卡片的某些数值。

sents.zh: 表 1 和 § 3.2 报告了不同情况下的差距。

sents.zh: 在提示接触了另一张卡片后立即进行的出牌（间接引用），将通过下文描述的更精细分类进行追踪。

paragraphs.en: The second system is induced from the data. Every play is described by six components of its context: the partner’s immediately preceding action, its relation to the board, the card’s ordered hint history, the lag since the last hint that touched it, hand position, and the hint-token stock. Games are split 50/50 into discovery and estimation halves. Every context type that clears a minimum cell size n min n_{\min} on the discovery half becomes its own category, and rarer types merge by hierarchical backoff, so there is no opaque other bucket. n min n_{\min} is derived from the empirical residual standard deviation at a ± 5 ​ pp \pm 5\,\text{pp} precision target, giving 52–139 across levels. A depth-4 CART tree ( Breiman et al., 1984 ) fit on the same discovery half gives a compact summary of each taxonomy (Appendix A ). All reported statistics come from the estimation half. The level-5 categories, once fit, are also kept fixed and applied unchanged to other populations; we call this the frozen level-5 taxonomy.
paragraphs.zh: 第二个系统是从数据中推导出来的。 每次博弈都由其上下文的六个要素描述：搭档在紧邻前一步的操作、该操作与棋盘的关联、卡牌的有序提示历史、自上次提示触及该卡牌以来的延迟时间、手牌位置以及提示令牌库存。 游戏按 50/50 的比例划分为探索阶段和评估阶段。 在探索阶段，每个能够清除最小单元格尺寸 n min n_{\min} 的上下文类型都会成为独立的类别；而更稀有的类型则通过层级回退进行合并，因此不存在不透明的“其他”类别。n min n_{\min} 是根据 ±5 ​ pp \pm 5\,\text{pp} 精度目标下的经验残差标准差推导得出，各级别的取值范围为 52–139。 基于同一探索阶段数据拟合的深度为 4 的 CART 树（Breiman et al., 1984）为每种分类体系提供了简洁的摘要（附录 A）。 所有报告的统计数据均来自评估阶段。 一旦完成拟合，第 5 级类别也会被固定下来，并直接应用于其他数据集；我们将其称为“冻结的第 5 级分类体系”。

paragraphs.en: For comparing populations, a shared taxonomy is defined jointly on all six: a cell exists only if every population’s discovery half supports it at its own n min n_{\min} , so every value can be estimated for everyone. Each cell is labeled by the components that define it; Fig. 1 gives the key. We call any situation or category with a positive gap a channel .
paragraphs.zh: 为了比较各个群体，我们在这六个要素上共同定义了一个共享的分类体系：一个单元格仅当每个群体的发现部分都在其自身的 n_{\min} 处支持该单元格时才存在，因此每个值都可以为所有群体进行估算。 每个单元格都由定义它的组成部分来标记；图 1 提供了关键说明。 我们将任何具有正差距的情况或类别称为一个通道。

paragraphs.en: Categories are observational: a category’s gap says how far its plays depart from the literal prediction, not what would happen if the channel were removed. We therefore intervene on the agents’ policies. When the acting player’s greedy action is to play a card whose context falls in a target category, that play is removed from the legal set and the best remaining action is taken from the same network outputs. The network is not re-run, and its recurrent state follows the real observations. All conditions share 1000 1000 environment seeds, so scores are compared per deck. Verification gates precede every full run (Appendix D ). Every score difference reported in § 3.3 is therefore between the same decks and the same network.
paragraphs.zh: 这些类别是观察性的：一个类别的“间隙”表示其出牌行为与字面预测的偏离程度，而不是如果移除该通道会发生什么。 因此，我们对智能体的策略进行干预。 当行动玩家的贪心动作是打出某张牌，而该牌的上下文落入目标类别时，这张牌将被从合法出牌集中移除，并从相同的网络输出中选择剩余的最佳动作。 网络不会重新运行，其循环状态会遵循实际的观察结果。 所有条件都共享 1000 个环境种子，因此得分是按牌组进行比较的。 验证门控在所有完整运行之前执行（附录 D）。 因此，§3.3 中报告的所有得分差异都是基于相同的牌组和相同的网络之间的比较。

paragraphs.en: The key part of the design is its control. Blocking any frequent play disturbs the game whatever its convention content, so a raw score drop says nothing about conventions. We therefore run frequency-matched random masks : the greedy play is blocked with a probability chosen to match a target category’s trigger rate, with no regard to its content, and these masks define a null cost curve. The quantity of interest is the excess cost : the paired score cost minus the random-mask cost at the same trigger rate, with the control curve re-fit inside every bootstrap draw. Three low-gap control categories at level 5 (two fully-identified-card cells and the large lag- 4 + 4{+} rank cell) check the control curve (§ 3.3 ). Negative score changes are losses.
paragraphs.zh: 设计的关键部分在于其控制机制。 阻止任何频繁操作都会干扰游戏，无论其规则内容如何，因此原始分数的下降无法说明任何问题。 因此，我们运行频率匹配的随机掩码：以匹配目标类别触发率的概率阻止贪婪操作，而不管其内容如何，这些掩码定义了一条零成本曲线。 我们关注的指标是超额成本：在相同触发率下，配对分数成本减去随机掩码成本，同时在每次自助抽样中重新拟合控制曲线。 第 5 级中三个差距较小的控制类别（两个完全识别的卡牌单元格以及较大的滞后 4 + 4{+} 排名单元格）用于验证控制曲线（§ 3.3）。 分数变化为负值即为损失。

paragraphs.en: How far above the OBL hierarchy does human play sit? The human corpus has a gap of + 26.16 ​ [ + 24.05 , + 28.28 ] ​ pp +26.16~[+24.05,+28.28]\,\text{pp} , against level 5’s + 21.68 ​ [ + 21.34 , + 22.02 ] ​ pp +21.68~[+21.34,+22.02]\,\text{pp} (Fig. 1 , top row; mean ± \pm SD over the five seed models: + 21.11 ± 1.53 ​ pp +21.11\pm 1.53\,\text{pp} , Appendix C ). Humans are therefore above every level of the hierarchy (level-by-level view and bot-exclusion sensitivity: Appendix E ).

paragraphs.en: Is the human margin spread across all situations, or concentrated in a few? Measured cell by cell on the shared taxonomy (§ 2.4 ; Fig. 1 ), it is concentrated. (Including the 11 11 cells where the human value exceeds every level’s, the distance keeps falling slightly; Appendix F .) What remains of the human margin sits in a few rare cells: ranking the cells by the human–level-5 difference puts the two indirect-reference cells and a delayed color cell at the top (Appendix Fig. 9 ).

paragraphs.en: Could the human margin simply reflect stronger play? Level 5 outscores the average human game ( 24.16 24.16 against the corpus mean of 18.52 18.52 ), while humans have the larger gap. The gap says how far plays depart from their literal prediction, not how high a player scores. Two score-selected corpora point the same way. The AH2AC2 corpus, whose selection rule puts its mean score ( 23.45 23.45 ) close to level 5’s, has a gap of + 27.62 ​ [ + 27.27 , + 27.97 ] ​ pp +27.62~[+27.27,+27.97]\,\text{pp} , and hanab.live games above the same score floor give + 27.20 ​ [ + 26.29 , + 28.04 ] ​ pp +27.20~[+26.29,+28.04]\,\text{pp} (Appendix E ). Both select on final score, and so on failed plays, so they describe these games rather than control for skill. Because the platform’s community publishes and teaches a convention system, the estimate describes taught play, not typical human play.
paragraphs.zh: 人类的得分差异是否仅仅反映了更强的游戏水平？ 第 5 级的得分高于平均人类游戏（24.16 对比语料库均值 18.52），而人类之间的差距更大。 这一差距表示棋局偏离其字面预测的程度，而非玩家得分的高低。 两个基于分数筛选的语料库都指向了相同的结果。 AH2AC2 语料库的选择规则使其平均得分（23.45）接近第 5 级的水平，其差距为 +27.62​ [ +27.27 , +27.97 ]​ pp +27.62~[+27.27,+27.97]\,\text{pp}；而 hanab.live 平台上高于相同分数门槛的游戏则给出 +27.20​ [ +26.29 , +28.04 ]​ pp +27.20~[+26.29,+28.04]\,\text{pp}（附录 E）。 两者都基于最终分数进行筛选，因此也包含了失败的棋局，所以它们描述的是这些游戏本身，而非对技能水平进行控制。 由于该平台社区会发布并教授一套规则体系，因此这一估计值反映的是经过教学的游戏方式，而非典型的人类游戏方式。

paragraphs.en: We next replicated the profile on a second corpus. The AH2AC2 benchmark ( Dizdarević et al., 2025 ) independently released 1858 1858 two-player games from the same platform and community; the two collections share no game records. Replayed through the identical pipeline, this corpus has a gap of + 27.62 ​ [ + 27.27 , + 27.97 ] ​ pp +27.62~[+27.27,+27.97]\,\text{pp} against the hanab.live corpus’s + 26.16 ​ [ + 25.31 , + 26.99 ] ​ pp +26.16~[+25.31,+26.99]\,\text{pp} , both clustered by game (AH2AC2 has no player identifiers, so pair clustering is not possible). Its category profile correlates with that of the hanab.live corpus at r = 0.97 r=0.97 , and it shows the same indirect-reference excess. Its differences are consistent with its selection rule, and on the sub-population the two corpora share, the cell values agree closely ( + 50.4 +50.4 against + 50.5 ​ pp +50.5\,\text{pp} on color-known cards). The structure and the indirect-reference excess are properties of the community’s play, not of how the hanab.live corpus was built (Appendix E ).

paragraphs.en: The two populations differ not only in a situation’s gap but in how often they enter it at all (Table 1 ). The dominant shared situation is a mirror image: level 5 puts 40.4 % 40.4\% of its plays into the fresh color-hint response, against 29.0 % 29.0\% for humans. Indirect reference shows the opposite pattern: humans enter it 2.64 % 2.64\% of the time against level 5’s 0.28 % 0.28\% , and they play unhinted cards 2.9 % 2.9\% (newest card) and 2.5 % 2.5\% (older cards) of the time, where level 5 almost never does. Level 5 does not merely have a smaller gap in these situations; it seldom enters them.
paragraphs.zh: 这两个群体不仅在情境的差距上存在差异，而且它们进入该情境的频率也存在不同（表 1）。 主导的共同情境则呈现出镜像模式：第 5 级将 40.4 % 40.4\% 的博弈置于新的颜色提示响应中，而人类则为 29.0 % 29.0\%。 间接引用则显示出相反的模式：人类有 2.64 % 2.64\% 的概率进入该情境，而第 5 级仅为 0.28 % 0.28\%；此外，人类有 2.9 % 2.9\%（最新卡牌）和 2.5 % 2.5\%（旧卡牌）的概率打出无提示的卡牌，而第 5 级几乎从不这样做。 第 5 级在这些情境中不仅差距更小，而且很少进入这些情境。

paragraphs.en: Where the partner’s hint touched a different card, humans reach + 61.3 ​ [ + 54.4 , + 66.0 ] ​ pp +61.3~[+54.4,+66.0]\,\text{pp} against level 5’s + 13.7 ​ pp +13.7\,\text{pp} ( n = 238 n=238 human plays); for rank hints the values are + 41.1 ​ [ + 31.9 , + 48.8 ] +41.1~[+31.9,+48.8] against + 10.3 ​ pp +10.3\,\text{pp} . The sharpest case is an unhinted card played immediately after a color hint that touched another card ( n = 193 n=193 ). There, the literal failure probability is 69.6 % 69.6\% , but the actual failure rate is only 5.7 % 5.7\% (Appendix Table 6 ). Level 5 rarely makes this play, and its gap there is small (Appendix Fig. 10 ). The human pattern matches a taught convention (the community’s finesse ) in which a hint about one card tells the partner to play a different card from an agreed slot (§ 4 discusses why the hierarchy may lack it).

paragraphs.en: Indirect reference sits in merged cells of the shared taxonomy, which collect the finer situations that did not reach every population’s n min n_{\min} . A single label can therefore hold different plays for different populations, so we asked whether the split survives a finer classification. Splitting the two indirect-reference cells by the played card’s own hint history shows that it does (Appendix Fig. 10 ), and the difference has three parts that all point the same way. Occupancy : humans enter “after the partner color-hinted a different card” mostly holding unhinted cards, the finesse configuration, while the hierarchy’s rare entries hold rank-known or fully-identified cards. The human-specific sub-cells are nearly empty for every agent level, and that emptiness is itself a finding. Rate on matched sub-populations : where both populations do occupy a sub-cell, the difference remains. On the finesse sub-cells humans read + 63.9 +63.9 and + 45.4 ​ pp +45.4\,\text{pp} against level 5’s + 6.1 +6.1 and + 1.6 ​ pp +1.6\,\text{pp} ; on the color-known sub-cell, + 50.5 +50.5 against + 26.3 ​ pp +26.3\,\text{pp} with non-overlapping intervals; and this color-known sub-cell agrees closely across the two corpora (§ 3.1.2 ). Configuration : which cards a population holds when it acts in these situations suggests a different rule for when such a play is allowed. (The merged shared-taxonomy cells of Fig. 1 average over this composition, which is why their values sit below the frozen-cell values quoted here.) Thus the finer classification does not dissolve the finding; it sharpens it.
paragraphs.zh: 间接引用位于共享分类法中的合并单元格内，这些单元格收集了未能达到每个群体 n min n_{\min} 的更精细情况。 因此，单个标签可以为不同群体承载不同的出牌方式，所以我们想知道这种划分是否能在更精细的分类中依然成立。 根据所出卡牌自身的提示历史对两个间接引用单元格进行拆分，可以发现这种划分确实存在（附录图10），且差异包含三个部分，所有部分都指向同一方向。 占据情况：人类在“搭档提示了不同颜色的卡牌之后”进入该状态时，主要持有未受提示的卡牌（即精细操作配置），而层级结构中罕见的条目则持有等级已知或完全识别的卡牌。 对于每个智能体层级而言，专属于人类的子单元格几乎为空，而这种空本身就是一个研究结果。 匹配子群体的比率：当两个群体都占据某个子单元格时，差异仍然存在。 在精细操作子单元格中，人类读数为 +63.9、+63.9 和 +45.4 pp（+45.4\,\text{pp}），而第5级则为 +6.1、+6.1 和 +1.6 pp（+1.6\,\text{pp}）；在颜色已知子单元格中，读数为 +50.5 与 +26.3 pp（+26.3\,\text{pp}），且区间不重叠；此外，该颜色已知子单元格在两个语料库中的结果高度一致（§3.1.2）。 配置：群体在这些情境中行动时所持有的卡牌，暗示了允许此类出牌的条件遵循不同的规则。 （图1中共享分类法的合并单元格对这一构成进行了平均计算，因此其数值低于此处引用的固定单元格数值。）由此可见，更精细的分类并未消解这一发现，反而使其更加明确。

paragraphs.en: To locate the gap, we attach to each play its context (turn, the hint history of the played card, the partner’s immediately preceding action, hand position, and token state) and ask when, in which situations, and in which feature of the game state it sits.
paragraphs.zh: 为了定位这一差距，我们将每张牌的上下文信息（回合数、已出牌的提示历史、搭档的紧邻前一次行动、手牌位置以及代币状态）附加到该牌上，并询问它出现在何时、何种情境下，以及在游戏状态的哪个特征中。

paragraphs.en: We first broke the gap down by turn. For levels 2–5 the gap follows an inverted U over the game: close to zero in the opening ( + 3.5 +3.5 to + 6.8 ​ pp +6.8\,\text{pp} in turns 0–4), peaking in the mid-game ( + 36.7 ​ pp +36.7\,\text{pp} at level 5, in the 5-turn bin starting at turn 20 20 ), then falling to between + 4.1 +4.1 and + 6.2 ​ pp +6.2\,\text{pp} late (Fig. 3 a). Level 1 stays low throughout (+0.3 to +4.6 pp across all bins). At level 5 the shape comes from the literal risk of the chosen plays: the actual failure rate is flat at 1.9–3.2% across all bins, while the mean literal failure probability rises and falls (Fig. 3 b). In this sense conventions are used most in the mid-game: there the plays carry the most literal risk yet fail no more often.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先按回合逐步缩小了差距。 在第 2–5 级中，整个游戏过程中差距呈现倒 U 形：开局阶段接近零（第 0–4 回合为 +3.5 至 +6.8 pp），中期达到峰值（第 5 级时，从第 20 回合开始的 5 回合区间内为 +36.7 pp），随后在后期降至 +4.1 至 +6.2 pp 之间（图 3a）。 第 1 级在整个过程中始终保持较低水平（所有区间内为 +0.3 至 +4.6 pp）。 在第 5 级，这种形态源于所选着法所带来的实际风险：实际失败率在所有区间内均稳定在 1.9–3.2%，而平均实际失败概率则呈现波动变化（图 3b）。 从这个意义上说，惯例在中段游戏阶段使用最为频繁：此时着法带来的实际风险最高，但失败频率并未随之增加。

paragraphs.en: We next sorted every play into the five hand-crafted situations. One situation dominates: a card played immediately after the partner color-hinted it. A color hint gives the suit and says nothing about the rank, so playing at once is reckless by the literal reading. At level 5 such plays have a mean literal failure probability of 41.1 % 41.1\% but fail only 0.8 % 0.8\% of the time, a gap of + 40.3 ​ [ + 39.7 , + 40.9 ] ​ pp +40.3~[+39.7,+40.9]\,\text{pp} . The situation grows from 18.1 % 18.1\% of plays at level 1 to 40.4 % 40.4\% at level 5, while its gap grows from + 1.0 +1.0 to + 40.3 ​ pp +40.3\,\text{pp} (Table 1 ). That one situation contributes 75.1 % 75.1\% of level 5’s total gap (share × \times gap in Table 1 , over the level-5 total). To a first approximation, the rise of the gap with level reflects both partners’ step-by-step adoption of one rule: a color hint marks a card as playable.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们将每一手牌归入五种手工设计的牌局情境中。 其中一种情境占主导地位：在搭档发出花色提示后立即打出该花色的一张牌。 花色提示仅表明花色，并未说明牌点，因此根据字面解读，立即打出这张牌是鲁莽的。 在第 5 级中，这类出牌的平均字面失败概率为 41.1%（41.1\%），但实际失败率仅为 0.8%（0.8\%），两者相差 +40.3 [ +39.7 , +40.9 ] pp（+40.3~[+39.7,+40.9]\,\text{pp}）。 这种情境在第 1 级时占所有出牌的 18.1%（18.1\%），到第 5 级则增至 40.4%（40.4\%），其差距也从 +1.0（+1.0）扩大到 +40.3 pp（+40.3\,\text{pp}）（见表 1）。 在第 5 级的总差距中，这一种情境贡献了 75.1%（75.1\%）（见表 1 中的“占比 × 差距”项，与第 5 级总和相比）。 初步来看，随着等级提升而扩大的差距，反映了双方逐步采用了一条规则：花色提示标志着某张牌可以打出。

paragraphs.en: Unhinted plays change sign across the OBL hierarchy. They are rare and, read literally, risky. Level 1 loses more often than literal chance predicts ( − 13.9 ​ [ − 17.6 , − 9.9 ] ​ pp -13.9~[-17.6,-9.9]\,\text{pp} on the newest card), while level 5 reaches + 23.5 ​ [ + 17.3 , + 29.6 ] ​ pp +23.5~[+17.3,+29.6]\,\text{pp} in the same situation. paragraphs.en: If high-gap channels mark conventions the policy relies on, then blocking them should cost more score than blocking equally frequent plays at random (design in § 2.5 ). It does, but only when several channels are blocked together, and how it does is the finding: the taxonomy ranks categories by their contribution to the gap, and that ranking does not predict what removing a channel costs.
paragraphs.zh: 如果高差距通道标志着该策略所依赖的惯例，那么阻断它们所损失的分数应该比随机阻断频率相同的走法更多（设计见第 2.5 节）。 确实如此，但仅当多个通道被同时阻断时才会发生，而具体机制正是研究的发现：分类体系根据各类别对差距的贡献度进行排序，但这种排序无法预测移除某个通道所导致的分数损失。

paragraphs.en: We first masked the OBL hierarchy’s dominant convention as a whole. Blocking the immediate response to a partner color hint, for both players, changes score by − 2.03 ​ [ − 2.25 , − 1.81 ] -2.03~[-2.25,-1.81] points at level 5 ( 24.10 → 22.07 24.10\rightarrow 22.07 ). Blocking it for one player has a little under half that effect ( − 0.92 ​ [ − 1.10 , − 0.73 ] -0.92~[-1.10,-0.73] ), and only the blocked player’s gap moves ( + 22.0 ​ [ + 21.43 , + 22.48 ] → + 15.5 ​ [ + 14.94 , + 15.97 ] ​ pp +22.0~[+21.43,+22.48]\rightarrow+15.5~[+14.94,+15.97]\,\text{pp} , against + 20.6 ​ [ + 20.16 , + 21.13 ] → + 20.1 ​ [ + 19.56 , + 20.56 ] ​ pp +20.6~[+20.16,+21.13]\rightarrow+20.1~[+19.56,+20.56]\,\text{pp} for the partner; Appendix D ).

sents.en: We first masked the OBL hierarchy’s dominant convention as a whole.
sents.zh: 我们首先将整个 OBL 层级的主导惯例进行了遮蔽。

sents.en: Blocking the immediate response to a partner color hint, for both players, changes score by − 2.03 ​ [ − 2.25 , − 1.81 ] -2.03~[-2.25,-1.81] points at level 5 ( 24.10 → 22.07 24.10\rightarrow 22.07 ).

paragraphs.en: But the blocked convention is not destroyed; it is rerouted. Under the immediacy mask the displaced plays reappear one turn later: the hinted earlier share doubles ( 34 % → 66 % 34\%\rightarrow 66\% ) and its gap triples ( + 6.4 ​ [ + 5.9 , + 6.9 ] → + 17.5 ​ [ + 17.1 , + 18.0 ] ​ pp +6.4~[+5.9,+6.9]\rightarrow+17.5~[+17.1,+18.0]\,\text{pp} ) at an unchanged loss rate. The convention’s content survives; only its timing breaks, and the score loss is consistent with a cost of delay. Removing these plays instead, by forbidding the play of color-hinted-only cards altogether, changes score by − 5.77 ​ [ − 6.04 , − 5.49 ] -5.77~[-6.04,-5.49] points and collapses the gap to + 3.5 ​ [ + 3.17 , + 3.74 ] ​ pp +3.5~[+3.17,+3.74]\,\text{pp} , with the replaced actions shifting toward discards ( 40 % 40\% ; Appendix D ). The two masks leave different marks on the time course (Fig. 4 a). The same immediacy mask at level 2 changes score by − 1.21 ​ [ − 1.38 , − 1.04 ] -1.21~[-1.38,-1.04] : the cue matters there too, but less.
paragraphs.zh: 但被阻断的惯例并未被破坏，而是被重新引导了。 在即时性掩膜下，被转移的出牌行为会在一个回合后再次出现：之前暗示的份额会翻倍（34% → 66% 34\%\rightarrow 66\%），而差距则会扩大三倍（+6.4 [ +5.9 , +6.9 ] → +17.5 [ +17.1 , +18.0 ] pp +6.4~[+5.9,+6.9]\rightarrow+17.5~[+17.1,+18.0]\,\text{pp}），且损失率保持不变。 惯例的内容得以保留，只有其执行时机被打破，而分数损失与延迟成本一致。 相反，如果通过完全禁止仅提示颜色的卡牌出牌来移除这些出牌行为，则分数将变化 −5.77 [ −6.04 , −5.49 ] -5.77~[-6.04,-5.49] 分，差距将缩小至 +3.5 [ +3.17 , +3.74 ] pp +3.5~[+3.17,+3.74]\,\text{pp}，而被替换的动作则会转向弃牌（40% 40\%；附录 D）。 这两种掩膜对时间进程留下了不同的印记（图 4a）。 在级别 2 下使用相同的即时性掩膜会使分数变化 −1.21 [ −1.38 , −1.04 ] -1.21~[-1.38,-1.04]：提示在此处同样有影响，但程度较小。

paragraphs.en: We next asked whether the observational ranking predicts the cost of removal. We masked each of the top eight categories by observational contribution (share × \times gap) one at a time (Fig. 4 b). The three low-gap control categories give excess costs of + 0.05 ​ [ − 0.08 , + 0.18 ] +0.05~[-0.08,+0.18] , + 0.09 ​ [ + 0.01 , + 0.18 ] +0.09~[+0.01,+0.18] and − 0.00 ​ [ − 0.10 , + 0.10 ] -0.00~[-0.10,+0.10] points, so the control curve is accurate to about a tenth of a point: the size of the single-mask excesses below, and an order of magnitude below the joint-mask interaction of § 3.3 . Only the two largest-contribution categories have negative excess estimates ( − 0.12 ​ [ − 0.25 , + 0.01 ] -0.12~[-0.25,+0.01] and − 0.09 ​ [ − 0.23 , + 0.03 ] -0.09~[-0.23,+0.03] points), and both intervals reach zero. Apart from category #6, the others lie between − 0.02 -0.02 and + 0.03 +0.03 . With eight categories, two of which carry most of the leverage, we do not read a dose–response relation into them (Appendix D ). Even the top category is mostly generic disruption. Category #1 holds 12.6 % 12.6\% of plays at + 57 ​ pp +57\,\text{pp} , and masking it changes score by − 0.39 ​ [ − 0.51 , − 0.26 ] -0.39~[-0.51,-0.26] points raw, but a random mask at the same trigger rate already changes it by − 0.27 -0.27 (Appendix Table 5 ); the excess specific to the convention is only − 0.12 ​ [ − 0.25 , + 0.01 ] -0.12~[-0.25,+0.01] . Thus most of a single mask’s cost is disruption, not lost meaning.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们询问观察排名是否能预测移除成本。 我们将按观察贡献度（份额 × \times 差距）排序的前八类逐一进行遮蔽（图 4b）。 三个低差距对照类别的超额成本分别为 +0.05 [−0.08, +0.18]、+0.09 [+0.01, +0.18] 和 −0.00 [−0.10, +0.10] 分，因此对照曲线的精度约为十分之一分：即下文单次遮蔽超额量的大小，且比 §3.3 中联合遮蔽的相互作用小一个数量级。 只有贡献度最大的两个类别具有负超额估计值（−0.12 [−0.25, +0.01] 和 −0.09 [−0.23, +0.03] 分），且两者的置信区间都触及零。 除了第 6 类，其余类别的数值均介于 −0.02 和 +0.03 之间。 在八类中，有两类承担了大部分影响力，因此我们并未从中解读出剂量-反应关系（附录 D）。 即便是贡献最大的类别，其影响也主要是泛化的干扰。 第 1 类包含 12.6% 的博弈，对应 +57 pp；遮蔽它会使原始得分变化 −0.39 [−0.51, −0.26] 分，但相同触发率下的随机遮蔽已使得分变化 −0.27（附录表 5）；因此，与惯例相关的超额影响仅为 −0.12 [−0.25, +0.01]。 因此，单次遮蔽的成本主要源于干扰，而非意义的丧失。

paragraphs.en: If single masks are cheap because meaning reroutes, then closing the substitutes together should cost more than their sum. It does. Masking the top eight categories together changes score by − 1.84 -1.84 points, against − 0.77 -0.77 for the sum of the eight single masks, a super-additive interaction of − 1.08 ​ [ − 1.47 , − 0.72 ] -1.08~[-1.47,-0.72] points (joint minus summed; Fig. 4 c), and lowers the total gap by a third, from 21.3 21.3 to 14.3 ​ [ + 14.00 , + 14.68 ] ​ pp 14.3~[+14.00,+14.68]\,\text{pp} (Appendix Table 5 ). This is consistent with rerouting: each single mask leaves substitute channels open, and joint masks close them together (the redistribution is in Appendix D ).

paragraphs.en: The interventions push both agents off their training distribution, so these costs are upper bounds under retraining: they price a channel for this fixed pair of policies.
paragraphs.zh: 这些干预措施使两个智能体都偏离了其训练分布，因此这些成本是重新训练情况下的上限：它们为这一固定的策略对设定了一个通道的价格。

paragraphs.en: In this study, we placed human play and the OBL hierarchy on one scale, broke the convention gap down by situation and by turn, and intervened on the agents’ policies against a frequency-matched control. We found that the two populations behave alike in frequent situations, differ in indirect reference, where no level approaches the human gap, and that a convention’s gap contribution does not predict what its removal costs.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项研究中，我们将人类的游戏行为与 OBL 层级置于同一衡量标准上，按情境和轮次分解了惯例差异，并针对频率匹配的控制组对智能体的策略进行了干预。 我们发现，这两种群体在高频情境中的表现相似，但在间接指代方面存在差异——此时没有任何层级能接近人类与惯例之间的差距；此外，某种惯例对差距的贡献度并不能预测移除该惯例所需付出的代价。

sents.en: In this study, we placed human play and the OBL hierarchy on one scale, broke the convention gap down by situation and by turn, and intervened on the agents’ policies against a frequency-matched control.

paragraphs.en: On the conventions the populations share (everything frequent), they are similar cell by cell, and humans are not significantly closer to level 5 than to level 2. The differences that survive every control are differences in kind , not only in size. Indirect reference shows a human gap that no level approaches: + 50.5 +50.5 against level 5’s + 26.3 ​ pp +26.3\,\text{pp} on the color-known sub-cell, replicated across two independently collected corpora. On unhinted cards that do not follow a hint to another card, the human gap differs from level 5’s by + 5.3 ​ [ − 7.7 , + 17.1 ] ​ pp +5.3~[-7.7,+17.1]\,\text{pp} . Humans also enter indirect reference far more often, and their gap rises earlier and stays high longer. The score-selected AH2AC2 corpus shows the same pattern, and clones trained on human play keep the shared conventions while losing the human-specific cells (Appendix H ). The populations have similar gaps on the conventions they share and differ on indirect reference.

paragraphs.en: The split in § 3.3 may apply beyond Hanabi. Removing the eight highest-contribution conventions cuts the total gap by a third but costs under two points of score, consistent with rerouting. The cost appears only when the substitutes are closed together, and then it is more than additive. A channel’s gap contribution and how hard it is to replace are therefore different quantities. Any interpretability method that ranks channels by an observational measure and reads that ranking as importance may inherit this problem; the fix is joint ablation against a matched null (§ 3.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: § 3.3 中的划分可能不仅适用于 Hanabi。 移除贡献度最高的八项惯例可将总差距减少三分之一，但代价不足两分，这与重新规划路线的情况一致。 这种成本仅在替代项被同时关闭时才会出现，且此时其影响会超过简单相加。 因此，一个通道的差距贡献度与其被替换的难度是两个不同的量。 任何通过观察性指标对通道进行排序并将其排序结果解释为重要性的可解释性方法，都可能会继承这一问题；解决之道是结合匹配的空对照进行联合消融分析（§ 3.3）。

paragraphs.en: Off-belief learning’s level 1 is trained to read past actions only for their literal content, which needs no shared convention. Human players appear to coordinate the opposite way: they arrive already sharing a taught system (Appendix E.5 ), and their gap rises earlier in the game than the agents’ (§ 3.2 ). Indirect reference suggests what is missing: a representation of hints as speech acts about the whole hand ( Frank and Goodman, 2012 ) rather than as signals about the touched card. Off-belief learning reads each past action as if a fixed base policy had produced it, so a hint on card A carries only what that policy put into it, and level 5 seldom plays card B after it. Depth alone does not account for the difference (Appendix F.7 ). One interpretation is that a hierarchy whose beliefs rest on a fixed base policy cannot express such a hint.
paragraphs.zh: 离信念学习的第 1 级仅被训练来读取过往行动的字面内容，这无需任何共享的约定。 人类玩家似乎以相反的方式协调：他们一开始就共享一个已教授的系统（附录 E.5），而且他们在游戏中的分歧比智能体更早出现（§ 3.2）。 间接引用暗示了缺失的部分：将提示表示为关于整手牌的言语行为（Frank 和 Goodman，2012），而不是关于被触碰卡牌的信号。 离信念学习将每次过往行动都视为由一个固定的基础策略所产生，因此关于卡牌 A 的提示仅包含该策略赋予它的内容，而第 5 级很少会在之后打出卡牌 B。 仅凭深度无法解释这种差异（附录 F.7）。 一种解释是，其信念建立在固定基础策略之上的层级结构无法表达此类提示。

paragraphs.en: The appendix adds four results: the realized gap depends on the partner (lower level in seat 0; Appendix B ); the agent-grown taxonomy transfers to human play (Appendix E ); depth of reasoning does not separate the populations (Appendix F ); and clones of both populations reproduce the split between shared conventions and human-specific cells (Appendix H ).
paragraphs.zh: 附录补充了四项结果：实际产生的差距取决于合作对象（座位 0 的较低层级；附录 B）；由智能体发展出的分类体系可迁移至人类对局中（附录 E）；推理深度无法区分这两个群体（附录 F）；并且，两个群体的克隆体都能再现共享惯例与人类特有单元之间的分化（附录 H）。

paragraphs.en: The category analysis is descriptive: categories are defined by the action the policy chose, so a category’s gap says how far its plays depart from the literal prediction, not what would happen if the situation were created on purpose. § 3.3 supplies the causal complement for the agents’ own conventions; indirect reference cannot be priced this way, because no level enters it often enough to mask. The human corpus comes from a community that publishes and teaches a convention system, so its estimates describe taught play, not typical human play; the pattern replicates on a second, score-selected corpus. All of this is one game; the method needs only an exact literal baseline and a maskable policy.
paragraphs.zh: 类别分析具有描述性：类别由策略所选择的行为定义，因此一个类别的差距反映了其棋局与字面预测的偏离程度，而非如果该情境被刻意创造时会发生什么。第 3.3 节为智能体自身的惯例提供了因果补充；间接引用无法以这种方式进行定价，因为没有哪个层级能足够频繁地参与其中以掩盖影响。 人类语料库来自一个发布并教授惯例系统的社群，因此其估计值描述的是被教授的棋局，而非典型的棋局表现；这一模式在第二个按分数筛选的语料库中得到了重复验证。 所有这些都属于同一款游戏；该方法仅需一个精确的字面基线和一个可掩码的策略。

Every game is replay-verified against its ground-truth score, all numbers were recomputed by a separate audit pipeline, and all our intervals but one bootstrap (Appendix G ) reproduce exactly from recorded seeds.

paragraphs.en: This appendix defines the literal observer behind Eq. 1 , the context descriptor and cell-size rule used to induce categories, and how the literal posterior rises with level.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录定义了方程 1 背后的字面观察者、用于归纳类别的上下文描述符和单元格大小规则，以及字面后验概率如何随层级上升而增加。

paragraphs.en: At a play action, the literal observer knows, for every card in the acting player’s hand, the set of identities consistent with all positive and negative hint constraints received so far, and it counts copies over every visible zone (the partner’s hand, the discard pile, the fireworks). Because a hint that touches one card constrains the identities available to another, the observer computes the joint distribution over the whole hand, weighting each joint assignment by the number of ways to draw it without replacement from the hidden pool, and marginalizes to the played card. The probability that the played card is unplayable under this distribution is the play’s literal failure probability P ⁡ ( life loss ) P(\text{life loss}) ; Eq. 1 averages it over a set of plays and subtracts the realized failure rate.
paragraphs.zh: 在一次出牌操作中，字面观察者知道，对于行动玩家手中的每一张牌，都存在一组与迄今为止收到的所有正向和负向提示约束一致的身份集合，并且它会针对每个可见区域（搭档的手牌、弃牌堆、烟花）统计这些身份的副本数量。 由于涉及一张牌的提示会限制另一张牌可用的身份，观察者会计算整手牌的联合分布，通过从隐藏牌池中无放回抽取该联合分配的方式数来对每种联合分配进行加权，然后将其边缘化到已出的这张牌上。 在此分布下，已出牌无法使用的概率即为此次出牌的字面失败概率 P⁡(life loss)；公式 1 会对此概率在一组出牌操作中取平均，并减去实际发生的失败率。

paragraphs.en: A schematic example with five plays illustrates the arithmetic (the values here are illustrative, not data). Suppose the literal failure probabilities of five played cards are 0.40 0.40 , 0.40 0.40 , 0.40 0.40 , 0.20 0.20 and 0.60 0.60 , and exactly one of the five plays fails. The mean literal failure probability, the literal price of the plays, is 0.40 0.40 ; the realized failure rate is 0.20 0.20 ; the gap is + 20 +20 percentage points: the plays succeeded more often than their literal information justified. A gap near zero does not mean the players were well informed, only that their success rate matches the literal price of the plays they chose. The gap is signed: plays can beat or miss their literal price. It cannot exceed the mean literal price.
paragraphs.zh: 一个包含五个博弈的示意图示例展示了算术计算（此处的数值仅为示意，并非实际数据）。 假设五张已出牌的字面失败概率分别为 0.40 0.40、0.40 0.40、0.40 0.40、0.20 0.20 和 0.60 0.60，且这五个博弈中恰好有一个失败。 平均字面失败概率，即这些博弈的字面价格，为 0.40 0.40；实际实现失败率为 0.20 0.20；两者差距为 +20% 的百分点：这些博弈的成功次数超过了其字面信息所应支持的频率。 接近零的差距并不意味着玩家获得了充分的信息，仅表示他们的成功率与他们所选博弈的字面价格相符。 该差距有正负之分：博弈可能优于或低于其字面价格。 该差距不能超过平均字面价格。

paragraphs.en: Two properties matter for everything downstream. First, the baseline is exact: there is no learned component, so a decomposition of the aggregate (by turn, by situation, by category) is free of model error. Second, the observer conditions on observation content but not on action choice : the fact that the partner chose this hint at this moment carries no weight. What the choice itself conveys can show up in the gap, but need not: subsets of plays with gaps of opposite sign can cancel, and plays whose outcome literal information fixes give a gap of exactly zero.
paragraphs.zh: 有两项特性对后续所有环节都至关重要。 首先，基线是精确的：其中没有学习成分，因此对汇总结果的分解（按轮次、按情境、按类别）不存在模型误差。 其次，观察者的条件取决于观察内容，而非行动选择：搭档在此时选择了这一提示这一事实本身并不具有任何权重。 选择本身所传达的信息可能体现在差异中，但并非必然：存在相反符号差异的子博弈集合可能会相互抵消，而结果由明确信息完全确定的博弈则会产生恰好为零的差异。

paragraphs.en: Every play is described by six components of its context:
paragraphs.zh: 每个剧本都由其语境的六个组成部分来描述：

paragraphs.en: Partner’s immediately preceding action : play, discard, color hint or rank hint, each hint distinguished by whether it touched the played card ( touch ) or a different card ( other ), or no preceding action (first move).
paragraphs.zh: 搭档的紧邻前一个动作：出牌、弃牌、花色提示或牌面提示；每种提示需区分其是否接触了已出的牌（接触），或是另一张牌（其他），或者没有前一个动作（第一手）。

paragraphs.en: Hint relation to the board (hints only): whether the hinted color’s stack is open, or the hinted rank is currently needed on some stack.
paragraphs.zh: 与牌堆相关的提示（仅提示）：被提示的颜色对应的牌堆是否开放，或者被提示的等级当前是否在某个牌堆中需要。

paragraphs.en: Hint history of the played card : the ordered pattern of hint types that ever touched it (none, C, R, CR, RC, CC+, RR+, or mixed, meaning three or more).
paragraphs.zh: 已出牌的卡牌的提示历史：曾作用于该卡牌的提示类型的有序模式（无、C、R、CR、RC、CC+、RR+ 或混合，即三种或以上）。

paragraphs.en: Lag : actions since the last hint that touched the card ( 1 1 , 2 2 – 3 3 , 4 + 4{+} , or unhinted). In two-player play only odd lags occur, so lag 2 2 – 3 3 means exactly one own action between the hint and the play.
paragraphs.zh: 延迟：自上次提示以来影响过该卡牌的智能体行动（1 1、2 2–3 3、4 + 4{+}，或未提示）。 在双人游戏中仅出现奇数延迟，因此延迟 2 2–3 3 表示提示与行动之间恰好有一次己方行动。

sents.en: Lag : actions since the last hint that touched the card ( 1 1 , 2 2 – 3 3 , 4 + 4{+} , or unhinted).
sents.zh: 延迟：自上次提示以来影响过该卡牌的智能体行动（1 1、2 2–3 3、4 + 4{+}，或未提示）。

sents.en: In two-player play only odd lags occur, so lag 2 2 – 3 3 means exactly one own action between the hint and the play.
sents.zh: 在双人游戏中仅出现奇数延迟，因此延迟 2 2–3 3 表示提示与行动之间恰好有一次己方行动。

paragraphs.en: Hint-token stock : 0 0 , 1 1 – 2 2 , or 3 + 3{+} tokens.

The cross-product yields 303–374 observed context types per level with a heavy-tailed frequency distribution; the number of types needed to cover 90 % 90\% of plays is, per level, OBL1=90, OBL2=74, OBL3=72, OBL4=70, OBL5=71.
paragraphs.zh: 叉积得出每层 303–374 种观测到的上下文类型，且其频率分布呈重尾特征；要覆盖 90% 的玩法，每层所需的类型数量分别为：OBL1=90、OBL2=74、OBL3=72、OBL4=70、OBL5=71。

paragraphs.en: The minimum cell size is derived, not chosen. With per-play residual standard deviation s s (empirically 0.18–0.30 across levels, discovery half), estimating a cell mean to ± 5 ​ pp \pm 5\,\text{pp} at 95 % 95\% confidence requires n min = ⌈ ( 1.96 ​ s / 0.05 ) 2 ⌉ n_{\min}=\lceil(1.96\,s/0.05)^{2}\rceil , giving 52–139 from level 1 to level 5. A ± 3 ​ pp \pm 3\,\text{pp} target would demand cells of 386 386 plays at level 5. Types that large cover only 77–82% (OBL2–5; OBL1 53%) of plays, below the 90 % 90\% coverage we required, so more plays would fall into merged cells.
paragraphs.zh: 最小单元格大小是通过计算得出的，而非人为选择的。 每次游戏的残差标准差为 s（经验上各关卡的取值范围为 0.18–0.30，取中间值），要在 95% 的置信水平下将单元格均值估计到 ±5 pp（±5\,\text{pp}），所需的最低样本量为 n_{\min}=\lceil(1.96\,s/0.05)^{2}\rceil，从第 1 关到第 5 关的取值范围为 52–139。 若目标精度为 ±3 pp（±3\,\text{pp}），则第 5 关的单元格需要包含 386 次游戏。 如此大的单元格类型仅能覆盖 77–82%（OBL2–5；OBL1 为 53%）的游戏，低于我们要求的 90% 覆盖率，因此会有更多游戏落入合并后的单元格中。

paragraphs.en: Types below n min n_{\min} merge by a fixed backoff ladder: drop tokens, then coarsen lag, then drop the board relation, then collapse hint history to its last type, then drop position, leaving at worst the partner’s preceding action alone. No play therefore falls into an opaque other bucket, and every merged cell retains a readable label. Categories and the CART tree are fit on a discovery half (games split 50/50 within level and seed, with a recorded split seed); every reported statistic (cell means, intervals, FDR flags, R 2 R^{2} ) comes from the held-out estimation half (Table 2 ). The per-category bootstrap intervals reproduce only up to bootstrap error (Appendix G ).
paragraphs.zh: 低于 n_{\min} 的类型通过固定的退避阶梯进行合并：首先丢弃标记，然后粗略化延迟，接着丢弃棋盘关系，再将提示历史坍缩为其最后一种类型，最后丢弃位置，最多仅保留对手的前一个动作。 因此，没有任何博弈会落入不透明的其他类别，且每个合并后的单元格都保留可读的标签。 分类和 CART 树基于发现阶段的一半数据拟合（游戏在层级和种子内部按 50/50 分割，并记录分割种子）；所有报告的统计量（单元格均值、区间、FDR 标志、R^{2}）均来自预留的估计阶段数据（表 2）。 各类别的自助法置信区间仅能再现至自助法误差范围内（附录 G）。

paragraphs.en: The mean literal posterior is a property of which plays a policy selects, not of the game. In self-play it rises from 7.8 % 7.8\% (level 1) to 24.1 % 24.1\% (level 5); the previous study reports this rise and the same plays by hint count [ Fukushima et al., 2026 ] . We split this rise into two simultaneous shifts. Composition : higher levels shift plays from cards touched by two or more hints to cards touched by one. The share of plays on a card touched by exactly one hint grows from 39 % 39\% to 61 % 61\% , while plays on cards touched by two or more hints shrink from 56 % 56\% to 38 % 38\% . Within-stratum : even among one-hint plays, higher levels accept literally riskier ones. The mean posterior within that stratum climbs from 12.8 % 12.8\% to 37.3 % 37.3\% while the realized loss rate of the same plays falls from 7.8 % 7.8\% to 2.9 % 2.9\% . A Kitagawa split of the rise [ Kitagawa, 1955 ] puts + 1.0 ​ pp +1.0\,\text{pp} in composition and + 15.2 ​ pp +15.2\,\text{pp} within strata, with the composition term evaluated at level-1 stratum posteriors and the within-stratum term at level-5 shares. This is an accounting identity and assigns no cause. At these weights the composition term is small, because the shrinking share of plays on cards no hint touched partially offsets the growing one-hint share.
paragraphs.zh: 平均字面后验概率是智能体选择策略的属性，而非游戏的属性。 在自我对弈中，该比例从 7.8 %（第 1 级）上升到 24.1 %（第 5 级）；先前的研究记录了这一上升，并指出提示次数相同的对弈也表现出同样的趋势 [ Fukushima et al., 2026 ]。 我们将这一上升分解为两个同时发生的转变。 构成变化：在更高级别中，智能体将选择从受两个或更多提示影响的卡牌转向仅受一个提示影响的卡牌。 仅受一个提示影响的卡牌被选择的比例从 39 % 上升到 61 %，而受两个或更多提示影响的卡牌被选择的比例则从 56 % 下降到 38 %。 层内变化：即使在仅受一个提示影响的卡牌中，更高级别的智能体也会接受字面上更具风险的选择。 在该层内，平均后验概率从 12.8 % 上升到 37.3 %，而相同选择的实际损失率则从 7.8 % 下降到 2.9 %。 根据 Kitagawa 对该上升的分解 [ Kitagawa, 1955 ]，构成变化贡献了 +1.0 pp，层内变化贡献了 +15.2 pp；其中构成项基于第 1 级的层内后验概率计算，层内项则基于第 5 级的选择比例计算。 这是一个会计恒等式，并未指出具体原因。 在这些权重下，构成项的影响较小，因为受零个提示影响的卡牌被选择比例的下降部分抵消了仅受一个提示影响的卡牌比例的增长。

paragraphs.en: Reading the trees across levels shows the phenomenon relocating (Table 3 ). At levels 2–3 the root split is hand position; by level 4 it is the played card’s hint history; at level 5 it is color-only knowledge outright. As the OBL hierarchy deepens, what the card is known to be rises from a sub-split to the primary axis of the policy’s gap. What carries the gap is not the freshness of the cue but the knowledge state the cue produced.
paragraphs.zh: 通过阅读不同层级的树状结构，可以发现该现象发生了转移（表3）。 在第2至3层级，根节点的分裂取决于手的位置；到第4层级时，则取决于所出卡牌的提示历史；到了第5层级，则完全取决于仅凭颜色的知识。 随着OBL层级结构的加深，卡牌所代表的已知信息从次要分支上升为策略差距的主要轴心。 决定这一差距的关键并非提示的新鲜度，而是该提示所产生的知识状态。

paragraphs.en: The sharpest evidence comes from lag, the number of actions since the last hint that touched the card. If hint meaning decayed over time, gaps would fall with lag. Instead, the two highest-gap categories in the whole level-5 taxonomy are delayed color-only plays: the card was color-hinted, the player did something else first, then played it. The lag- 2 2 – 3 3 category reads + 62.2 ​ [ + 60.1 , + 64.0 ] ​ pp +62.2~[+60.1,+64.0]\,\text{pp} and the lag- 4 + 4{+} category + 62.2 ​ [ + 60.0 , + 64.2 ] ​ pp +62.2~[+60.0,+64.2]\,\text{pp} , above the two largest fresh-hint categories at + 56.8 ​ [ + 56.4 , + 57.2 ] +56.8~[+56.4,+57.2] and + 55.6 ​ [ + 55.1 , + 56.2 ] ​ pp +55.6~[+55.1,+56.2]\,\text{pp} (all four values are level-5 self-play, estimation half). Thus the hint, or the later absence of a warning, carried information beyond literal content; the gap does not say which. The hand-crafted map filed all of these under hinted earlier at a diluted + 6.4 ​ pp +6.4\,\text{pp} , which is how a + 62.2 ​ pp +62.2\,\text{pp} category disappears into a + 6.4 ​ pp +6.4\,\text{pp} situation.
paragraphs.zh: 最有力的证据来自延迟（lag），即自上次提示涉及该卡牌以来所执行的操作数量。 如果提示的含义会随时间衰减，那么延迟越大的情况，其差距也应随之缩小。 然而，在整个第5级分类体系中，差距最大的两个类别恰恰是延迟的纯颜色操作：卡牌已给出颜色提示，但玩家先执行了其他操作，之后才打出该卡牌。 延迟为 2-2–3-3 的类别为 +62.2 [ +60.1 , +64.0 ] pp +62.2~[+60.1,+64.0]\,\text{pp}，而延迟为 4+4 的类别为 +62.2 [ +60.0 , +64.2 ] pp +62.2~[+60.0,+64.2]\,\text{pp}，均高于两个最大的即时提示类别：+56.8 [ +56.4 , +57.2 ] +56.8~[+56.4,+57.2] 和 +55.6 [ +55.1 , +56.2 ] pp +55.6~[+55.1,+56.2]\,\text{pp}（这四个数值均为第5级自我对弈的估计值的一半）。 因此，提示本身或随后缺乏警告这一现象，传递了超越字面内容的信息；但差距本身并未说明具体是哪种情况。 人工构建的地图将这些情况全部归入“较早提示”类别，其稀释后的影响仅为 +6.4 pp +6.4\,\text{pp}，这正是 +62.2 pp +62.2\,\text{pp} 的类别最终被消解为 +6.4 pp +6.4\,\text{pp} 局面的原因。

paragraphs.en: Two further structures the hand-crafted map misses. Hand position separates otherwise matched fresh-color categories by 12.7–32.5 pp (levels 2–5), and token scarcity shifts the same situation by a few points (+54.4 at 0 tokens vs +55.5/+57.0 at 1–2/3+ tokens). Despite roughly a hundred categories per level, a handful of categories carry 80 % 80\% of each level’s total gap (per level: OBL1=5, OBL2=7, OBL3=7, OBL4=7, OBL5=8). Seed-to-seed differences sit in the tail of the taxonomy (Appendix C ).
paragraphs.zh: 手工制作的地图还遗漏了另外两种结构。 手的位置使原本匹配的新颜色类别之间产生了 12.7–32.5 pp（第 2–5 级）的差异，而标记的稀缺性则使这一差异进一步偏移了几个百分点（0 个标记时为 +54.4，而在 1–2/3+ 个标记时则为 +55.5/+57.0）。 尽管每个级别大约有上百个类别，但仅有少数几个类别就占据了每个级别总差距的 80 % 80\%（各级别情况：OBL1=5，OBL2=7，OBL3=7，OBL4=7，OBL5=8）。 种子之间的差异位于分类体系的尾部（附录 C）。

paragraphs.en: This analysis is descriptive: categories condition on the action the policy chose, so a category’s gap says how far its plays depart from the literal prediction, not what would happen if the situation were induced. § 3.3 supplies the causal complement.
paragraphs.zh: 这项分析是描述性的：类别取决于策略所选择的行为，因此某一类别的差距反映了其行动与字面预测之间的偏离程度，而非如果该情境被诱发时会发生什么。第 3.3 节提供了因果方面的补充说明。

paragraphs.en: This appendix gives the analysis behind the statement in § 4 that the realized gap depends on the partner. § B.1 reports all ten mixed-level pairings, § B.2 localizes the effect in the fresh color-hint cue, and Appendix C repeats the per-agent comparison of § B.1 across seed combinations.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录对第 4 节中“实际差距取决于合作者”这一论断背后的分析进行了阐述。B.1 节报告了全部十种混合层级配对，B.2 节将这种效应定位到新的颜色提示线索上，而附录 C 则重复了 B.1 节中按智能体进行的跨种子组合的比较。

paragraphs.en: The self-play ladder rises with level. It does not say what happens when two levels meet. We played all ten mixed-level pairings ( 1000 1000 games each, replay-verified) and computed Δ \Delta separately for each side’s own plays (Fig. 7 ). In every game of this design the lower level held seat 0 and moved first, and this analysis uses no seat-reversed games. Each side’s statistics, and their comparison with self-play (which pools both seats), therefore include any seat effect. For scale, in the level-5 self-play baseline of § 3.3 , seat 0 has a gap of + 22.0 ​ [ + 21.43 , + 22.48 ] ​ pp +22.0~[+21.43,+22.48]\,\text{pp} and seat 1 + 20.6 ​ [ + 20.16 , + 21.13 ] ​ pp +20.6~[+20.16,+21.13]\,\text{pp} . The previous study reports level 1’s own gaps in these games [ Fukushima et al., 2026 ] ; the analysis below (the per-agent split across all ten pairings, its localization, and its seed behavior) is new here.

paragraphs.en: Paired with a higher level, level 1’s own aggregate gap falls toward zero: from + 1.0 ​ [ + 0.7 , + 1.3 ] ​ pp +1.0~[+0.7,+1.3]\,\text{pp} against level 2 to + 0.1 ​ [ − 0.2 , + 0.5 ] ​ pp +0.1~[-0.2,+0.5]\,\text{pp} against level 5, an interval that includes zero. A near-zero aggregate can still contain plays that depart from the literal prediction: on cards level 1 plays immediately after level 5 color-hinted them, its gap is + 1.9 ​ [ + 1.3 , + 2.4 ] ​ pp +1.9~[+1.3,+2.4]\,\text{pp} (§ B.2 ). The higher-level agent, whose policy is unchanged, has gaps of + 8.4 ​ [ + 8.0 , + 8.9 ] +8.4~[+8.0,+8.9] to + 9.0 ​ [ + 8.6 , + 9.4 ] ​ pp +9.0~[+8.6,+9.4]\,\text{pp} across the four level-1 pairings, against its own self-play values of + 12.40 ​ [ + 12.10 , + 12.71 ] +12.40~[+12.10,+12.71] to + 21.68 ​ [ + 21.34 , + 22.02 ] ​ pp +21.68~[+21.34,+22.02]\,\text{pp} . paragraphs.en: Appendix B reports single-seed pairings: one released model per level. This appendix asks whether its two results, the level-1 split and the blend among levels 2–5, depend on which seed models were paired. To test this, every pairing among levels 2–5, plus the level- 1 × 5 1{\times}5 control, was played for all 25 25 seed combinations (seeds a–e on each side, 200 200 games per combination; 35000 35000 games in total, each replay-verified). The unit of analysis is the seed combination: the primary statistic per level pair is the across-combination mean of the side difference δ = Δ higher − Δ lower \delta=\Delta_{\text{higher}}-\Delta_{\text{lower}} , with a t t -based 95 % 95\% interval over the 25 25 combinations (Table 4 ). The combinations share seed models on each side and are not independent replications, so the t t interval may be too narrow for inference beyond these models. As in Appendix B , the lower level held seat 0 in every game.
paragraphs.zh: 附录 B 报告了单种子配对：每个层级一个已发布的模型。 本附录探讨了其两个结果——层级 1 的分割以及层级 2–5 之间的混合——是否取决于所配对的种子模型。 为检验这一点，层级 2–5 之间的所有配对，以及层级 1 × 5 的 1{\times}5 对照组，均针对全部 25 种种子组合进行了对弈（每侧使用种子 a–e，每组合 200 局游戏；总计 35000 局游戏，每局均经重演验证）。 分析单位是种子组合：每个层级对的主要统计量是跨组合的边差异均值 δ = Δ_{\text{higher}}−Δ_{\text{lower}}，并基于 25 种组合计算 t 相关的 95% 置信区间（表 4）。 这些组合在每侧共享种子模型，且并非独立的重复实验，因此 t 置信区间可能过于狭窄，无法用于超出这些模型的推断。 与附录 B 一样，较低层级在所有游戏中均占据座位 0。

paragraphs.en: Within the induced taxonomy of § 2.4 , per-seed cell values were checked for the top-ten categories by absolute gap at each of levels 2–5 ( 40 40 cells; 18 18 flagged with across-seed excess variance beyond game-sampling noise). Head cells are seed-stable in relative terms: their excess standard deviations are 1.5–2.9 pp (3–9% of gap). Every large-excess flag sits in a tail cell holding at most 0.87% of plays: the widest are a discard-context color cell at level 3 (+13.9 to +44.8, excess 10.8 pp ), an unhinted cell at level 4 (+18.1 to +47.8, excess 8.2 pp ), and a repeat-color-hint cell at level 5 (+31.5 to +52.4, excess 7.5 pp ); each parenthesis gives the range across seeds and the excess standard deviation. Different training runs agree on the head of the taxonomy and differ in its tail.
paragraphs.zh: 在 § 2.4 中建立的分类体系内，针对每颗种子的细胞值，在 2–5 级各层级中按绝对差距筛选出前十类（共 40 个细胞；其中 18 个因跨种子方差超出游戏采样噪声而被标记）。 头部细胞在相对意义上是种子稳定的：其超额标准差为 1.5–2.9 pp（占差距的 3–9%）。 每个“大超额”标记都位于一个尾部细胞中，该细胞最多仅包含 0.87% 的游戏对局：其中最显著的是第 3 级的弃牌上下文颜色细胞（+13.9 至 +44.8，超额 10.8 pp）、第 4 级的无提示细胞（+18.1 至 +47.8，超额 8.2 pp）以及第 5 级的重复颜色提示细胞（+31.5 至 +52.4，超额 7.5 pp）；每个括号内的数值分别表示跨种子的范围与超额标准差。 不同的训练运行在分类体系的头部部分具有一致性，但在尾部部分存在差异。

paragraphs.en: This appendix gives the details behind the intervention results of § 3.3 : the verification gates, the full condition table, the replication of the one anomalous mask, and a category-level check of the rerouting. Apart from the level-2 contrast, the masks act on the seed-a model of level 5, which is in the released archive but not among the results published with OBL [ Hu et al., 2021 ] (§ 2.2 ); the replication adds level-5 seed b and level-4 seed a. The level-5 baseline uses this model on its own environment seeds, and its gap ( 21.3 ​ pp 21.3\,\text{pp} ) differs from the ladder value ( + 21.68 ​ pp +21.68\,\text{pp} ).
paragraphs.zh: 本附录详细说明了 § 3.3 中干预结果的相关细节：验证门、完整的条件表、对单个异常掩码的复现，以及对重路由的类别级检查。 除了第 2 级的对比之外，这些掩码还作用于第 5 级的模型 seed-a，该模型存在于已发布的存档中，但未包含在随 OBL [ Hu et al., 2021 ] (§ 2.2) 一同发布的结果中；复现部分还加入了第 5 级的 seed b 和第 4 级的 seed a。 第 5 级的基线模型在其自身的环境种子中使用该模型，其差距（21.3 pp 21.3\,\text{pp}）与阶梯值（+21.68 pp +21.68\,\text{pp}）存在差异。

paragraphs.en: Two gates precede every full run. First, the category that the masking code assigns to each play during the game must match the category that the analysis assigns afterwards; on the baseline games the two agree on every play a mask would block ( 24838 / 24838 24838/24838 ). Second, the masking code with no mask active must reproduce the baseline games: 1000 / 1000 1000/1000 games match action for action, deck and score. All mask conditions share environment seeds with the baseline, and the full 50 50 -card decks are identical per seed across every condition (1000/1000 for every condition), so score differences are paired per deck. Every condition replays to its ground-truth score.
paragraphs.zh: 每次完整运行之前都有两个关卡。 首先，掩码代码在游戏期间为每手牌分配的分类必须与分析代码事后分配的分类一致；在基准游戏中，两者对每手会被掩码阻挡的牌都达成一致（24838 / 24838 24838/24838）。 其次，在没有掩码激活的情况下，掩码代码必须能够重现基准游戏：1000 / 1000 1000/1000 局游戏在每手操作、牌组和得分上完全匹配。 所有掩码条件都与基准环境共享环境种子，并且在每个条件下，完整的 50 张 50 卡牌组在每个种子下都是相同的（每种条件均为 1000/1000），因此得分差异是按牌组配对的。 每种条件都会重新运行游戏，直至达到其真实基准得分。

paragraphs.en: Targets are the top eight categories by observational contribution (share × \times gap, estimation half) among categories holding at least 1 % 1\% of plays, three low-gap controls (two fully identified cells, whose gap is zero by construction, and the large low-gap rank cell at lag 4 + 4{+} ), and cumulative masks of the top 1 / 2 / 4 / 6 / 8 1/2/4/6/8 (top-1 coincides with single #1). Frequency-matched random controls suppress the greedy play with probability matched to the trigger rates of targets #1, #4 and #8 ( 3.76 / 0.61 / 0.24 3.76/0.61/0.24 triggers per game) and define the null cost curve: piecewise linear through the origin and the three controls in realized trigger rate, linearly extrapolated beyond the largest control rate, and re-fit inside every bootstrap draw so the excess interval carries the control curve’s own uncertainty. Rows whose realized trigger rate exceeds the largest control rate (the cumulative top-2, top-4, top-6 and top-8 masks) rely on that extrapolation and are marked † in Table 5 ; the super-additivity claim in § 3.3 uses raw paired costs and does not depend on it.
paragraphs.zh: 目标类别是观测贡献度（份额 × \times 差距，估计值减半）最高的八类类别，这些类别至少占到了 1 % 1\% 的博弈次数；此外还包括三个低差距对照类别（两个完全识别的单元格，其差距根据构造为零，以及滞后为 4 + 4{+} 时的一个大规模低差距排名单元格），以及前 1 / 2 / 4 / 6 / 8 1/2/4/6/8 的累积掩码（前 1 与单一第 #1 类别一致）。 频率匹配的随机对照类别以与目标 #1、#4 和 #8 的触发率相匹配的概率抑制贪婪博弈（每局游戏触发次数为 3.76 / 0.61 / 0.24 3.76/0.61/0.24），并定义了零成本曲线：该曲线以分段线性方式穿过原点和三个对照类别在已实现触发率处的点，在最大对照率之外进行线性外推，并在每次自助抽样中重新拟合，使得超额区间包含了对照曲线本身的不确定性。 那些已实现触发率超过最大对照率（即累积的前 2、前 4、前 6 和前 8 掩码）的行依赖于这种外推，并在表 5 中标记为 †；而 § 3.3 中的超可加性主张使用的是原始配对成本，并不依赖这种外推。

paragraphs.en: An ordinary least-squares fit of the eight single-mask excess costs on contribution gives a slope of − 2.87 ​ [ − 4.78 , − 0.98 ] -2.87~[-4.78,-0.98] points per unit of contribution (contribution as a probability; interval from the game-level bootstrap) with R 2 = 0.44 R^{2}=0.44 ; on the category’s gap alone R 2 = 0.72 R^{2}=0.72 , on its share alone 0.11 0.11 . We do not interpret these fits. They rest on eight cells, six of which sit within about one percentage point of contribution of each other, so categories #1 and #2 carry most of the leverage, and neither of their excess intervals excludes zero. paragraphs.en: The apparent score improvement from masking category #6 was re-tested out of sample before being interpreted: fresh decks disjoint from every prior condition, three agents (level-5 seeds a and b, level-4 seed a), each with its own baseline and frequency-matched random control, and a decision rule fixed in advance (replicates if all three excesses are positive and at least two per-agent intervals exclude zero; fails if the pooled interval contains zero). Outcome: inconclusive. The excesses are positive for all three agents ( + 0.14 ​ [ − 0.003 , + 0.292 ] +0.14~[-0.003,+0.292] , + 0.15 ​ [ + 0.035 , + 0.274 ] +0.15~[+0.035,+0.274] , + 0.06 ​ [ − 0.098 , + 0.205 ] +0.06~[-0.098,+0.205] ) and the inverse-variance pooled excess is + 0.12 ​ [ + 0.04 , + 0.20 ] +0.12~[+0.04,+0.20] , but only 1 1 per-agent interval excludes zero, and the raw score gain in Table 5 ( + 0.10 +0.10 points) did not reproduce. The supported reading is that this convention carries no detectable positive value (“cheaper than random disruption,” not beneficial), and that the first estimate was inflated by selecting among eight categories. The substitution pattern does reproduce: under the mask, 48–62% of masked plays substitute into another rank hint, as in the original run.

paragraphs.en: Applying the frozen taxonomy to the masked games checks the rerouting at category level, independently of the score analysis. Under the immediacy mask, level-5’s color-only lag-1 categories empty by construction (29.6% of baseline plays at + 55 ​ pp +55\,\text{pp} ) and many displaced plays reappear as color-only lag- 2 2 – 3 3 plays at nearly undiminished gap: that category’s share rises from 1.5% to 16.7% at + 53 ​ pp +53\,\text{pp} , with a smaller spill into lag 4 + 4{+} (3.1% → \rightarrow 6.1% at + 32 ​ pp +32\,\text{pp} ). Under the persistent mask the color-only categories stay empty (0.0%) and play shifts onto fully identified cards, whose gap is zero by construction (35.6% → \rightarrow 60.0% of plays). Level 2 reroutes less. Its delayed color-only gap at baseline is + 17 ​ pp +17\,\text{pp} , against level-5’s + 41 ​ pp +41\,\text{pp} , and under the immediacy mask its color-only lag- 2 2 – 3 3 share reaches 2.5%, against level-5’s 16.7%.

paragraphs.en: This appendix documents the two human corpora (provenance, filters, clustering and the convention community they come from) and gives the full versions of the human results summarized in § 3.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 本附录记录了两个人类语料库（其来源、筛选标准、聚类方式以及它们所属的惯例社群），并提供了第 3.1 节中总结的人类结果的完整版本。

paragraphs.en: The corpus is drawn from public logs of two-player, no-variant games on the hanab.live platform [ Hanab Live, 2026 ] , the platform the convention community plays on, with usernames replaced by salted hashes before any analysis. Two filters define the analysis set. The completed-games filter removes games whose logs end abnormally (timeouts, terminations, or logs that stop with cards in the deck and no terminal state). The bot exclusion has two tiers: a game-level tier for verified bot families matched by account-name pattern, and an account-level tier removing plays by flagged accounts (accounts that play almost only with verified bots, pairs of accounts with identical timing statistics, and accounts whose game notes carry a bot’s version tag; criteria as in the previous study [ Fukushima et al., 2026 ] , identified by hashed id). The result is 425 425 games, 9017 9017 plays, 155 155 players and 95 95 pairs. A sensitivity corpus applying only the verified-bot tier holds 598 598 games / 13089 13089 plays and gives + 27.52 ​ [ + 25.21 , + 29.69 ] ​ pp +27.52~[+25.21,+29.69]\,\text{pp} .
paragraphs.zh: 语料取自 hanab.live 平台上双人无变体游戏的公开日志 [ Hanab Live, 2026 ]，这是该游戏社群常用的平台；在分析前，所有用户名均被替换为加盐哈希值。 两个筛选条件共同定义了分析数据集。 “已完成游戏”筛选条件会排除那些日志异常终止的游戏（如超时、强制结束，或日志在牌堆仍有卡牌且未达成终局状态时中断）。 机器人排除机制分为两个层级：第一层是游戏级筛选，针对通过账户名模式匹配到的已验证机器人家族；第二层是账户级筛选，排除由被标记账户进行的对局（这些账户几乎只与已验证机器人对局、账户对的时间统计完全一致，或游戏笔记中包含机器人的版本标签；判断标准参考前一项研究 [ Fukushima et al., 2026 ]，通过哈希化 ID 进行识别）。 最终得到 425 局游戏、9017 次对局、155 名玩家和 95 对组合。 仅应用“已验证机器人”层级筛选的敏感性语料包含 598 局游戏 / 13089 次对局，并带来 +27.52​ [ +25.21 , +29.69 ] ​pp +27.52~[+25.21,+29.69]\,\text{pp} 的提升。

sents.zh: Tier-1 过滤器会移除所有经核实的机器人账户进行过操作的棋局。

sents.en: One game in which a verified bot only hinted and discarded is therefore retained; excluding it as well gives 424 424 games and 9,011 9{,}011 plays and a gap of + 26.18 ​ pp +26.18\,\text{pp} , against + 26.16 ​ pp +26.16\,\text{pp} [ Fukushima et al., 2026 ] .
sents.zh: 因此，有一局经核实的机器人仅给出提示便弃牌的棋局被保留；若将其一并排除，则得到 424,424 局棋局和 9,011,9{,}011 次操作，差距为 +26.18 pp +26.18\,\text{pp}，而 [ Fukushima et al., 2026 ] 中的差距为 +26.16 pp +26.16\,\text{pp}。

paragraphs.en: The identity is exact, not approximate, and was established by a three-part check: (i) the game sets are identical (sorted id lists, symmetric difference empty); (ii) the filter chain is the same code , imported rather than reimplemented; and (iii) the joint posteriors agree play-for-play, bit-identically, over all 9017 9017 plays against an independent run of the prior paper’s engine on the raw logs.
paragraphs.zh: 该身份是精确的，而非近似的，并通过三重验证得以确认：(i) 游戏集合完全相同（排序后的 ID 列表一致，对称差集为空）；(ii) 过滤链使用了相同的代码，且为导入而非重新实现；(iii) 在所有 9017 局游戏中，联合后验概率与独立运行先前论文引擎在原始日志上的结果逐局逐位完全一致。

paragraphs.en: Pairs recur across games, so the primary human intervals cluster at the pair level ( 95 95 pairs); game-clustered intervals are narrower. Side by side, joint posterior: corpus gap + 26.16 ​ [ + 24.05 , + 28.28 ] +26.16~[+24.05,+28.28] (pair) against [ + 25.32 , + 27.01 ] [+25.32,+27.01] (game); Tier-1-only sensitivity + 27.52 ​ [ + 25.21 , + 29.69 ] +27.52~[+25.21,+29.69] (pair) against [ + 26.79 , + 28.26 ] [+26.79,+28.26] (game). The documented exceptions are the nearest-level bootstrap and the mixture fit of Appendix F (§ F.2 and § F.3 ), which are game-clustered by design, for comparability with the agent corpora; their pair-clustered sensitivity is in § F.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 成对关系在不同游戏中反复出现，因此主要的人类间隔集中在成对层面（95 对）；按游戏分组的间隔则更窄。 并列比较联合后验分布：语料库差距为 +26.16 ​ [ +24.05 , +28.28 ] +26.16~[+24.05,+28.28]（成对），而按游戏分组的差距为 [ +25.32 , +27.01 ] [+25.32,+27.01]；仅 Tier-1 的敏感度为 +27.52 ​ [ +25.21 , +29.69 ] +27.52~[+25.21,+29.69]（成对），而按游戏分组的敏感度为 [ +26.79 , +28.26 ] [+26.79,+28.26]。 已记录的例外情况包括最近邻级别的自助法和附录 F 中的混合拟合（§ F.2 和 § F.3），这些方法在设计上就按游戏分组，以便与智能体语料库进行比较；它们按成对分组的敏感度见 § F.4。

paragraphs.en: The platform’s community publishes and teaches a convention system [ H-Group, 2026 ] : play hints and the focus rule, chop and save conventions, and the finesse family are written down rather than negotiated at the table. The human corpus therefore describes taught play, not typical human play. Pair experience, counted within the corpus, moves the gap little: stratifying pairs by games played together gives + 23.6 ​ [ + 20.2 , + 26.8 ] ​ pp +23.6~[+20.2,+26.8]\,\text{pp} (one game together, 36 36 pairs), + 25.7 ​ [ + 23.5 , + 27.8 ] ​ pp +25.7~[+23.5,+27.8]\,\text{pp} (2–4 games), and + 26.6 ​ [ + 23.8 , + 29.7 ] ​ pp +26.6~[+23.8,+29.7]\,\text{pp} (five or more), and near-strangers (one game together, both players in at most two corpus games) reach + 22.1 ​ [ + 17.8 , + 26.0 ] ​ pp +22.1~[+17.8,+26.0]\,\text{pp} . This is consistent with players who arrive already sharing a taught system.
paragraphs.zh: 该平台社区发布并教授了一套约定体系 [ H-Group, 2026 ]：出牌提示和核心规则、切牌与保留约定，以及精细操作系列规则都是事先写定的，而非在牌桌上协商确定。 因此，人类语料库描述的是经过教学后的打法，而非典型的自然打法。 语料库中统计的搭档经验对分差影响甚微：按共同游戏次数对搭档分层分析显示，共同玩 1 局（共 36 对搭档）时，分差为 +23.6 ​ [ +20.2 , +26.8 ] ​ pp +23.6~[+20.2,+26.8]\,\text{pp}；共同玩 2–4 局时为 +25.7 ​ [ +23.5 , +27.8 ] ​ pp +25.7~[+23.5,+27.8]\,\text{pp}；共同玩 5 局或以上时为 +26.6 ​ [ +23.8 , +29.7 ] ​ pp +26.6~[+23.8,+29.7]\,\text{pp}；而近乎陌生搭档（仅共同玩 1 局，且两名玩家最多只参与过语料库中的 2 局游戏）的分差为 +22.1 ​ [ +17.8 , +26.0 ] ​ pp +22.1~[+17.8,+26.0]\,\text{pp}。 这与那些入场时已共享一套教学体系的玩家的情况一致。

paragraphs.en: The replication corpus (§ 3.1.2 ) is processed identically from the open release: conversion to the common game format, replay verification against the released scores ( 1858 1858 of 1858 1858 games reproduce exactly), then the same completed-games criterion, which removes 106 106 games. Every one is a verifiable “no further points possible” early ending, a completed game our criterion nonetheless excludes; they are retained as a sensitivity ( + 27.59 ​ [ + 27.26 , + 27.92 ] ​ pp +27.59~[+27.26,+27.92]\,\text{pp} on the full release against + 27.62 ​ [ + 27.27 , + 27.97 ] ​ pp +27.62~[+27.27,+27.97]\,\text{pp} on the filtered corpus). The open data carry no player identifiers, so the bot exclusion cannot be applied and all AH2AC2 intervals cluster by game. Score selection in that collection (minimum recorded score 13 13 ; no strikeouts) is consistent with its higher aggregate (§ 3.1.2 ); restricting the hanab.live corpus to games at or above the same floor gives + 27.20 ​ [ + 26.29 , + 28.04 ] ​ pp +27.20~[+26.29,+28.04]\,\text{pp} over 338 338 games.
paragraphs.zh: 复制语料库（§ 3.1.2）以与公开版本相同的方式进行处理：转换为通用游戏格式，根据已发布的分数进行重播验证（1858 局游戏中的 1858 局完全一致），然后应用相同的已完成游戏标准，从而排除 106 局游戏。 每一局都是可验证的“无法再得分”的提前结束局，即我们的标准本应排除的已完成游戏；但为了敏感性分析，这些局仍被保留（在完整版本中为 +27.59 [ +27.26, +27.92 ] pp，而在过滤后的语料库中为 +27.62 [ +27.27, +27.97 ] pp）。 公开数据不包含任何玩家标识符，因此无法应用机器人排除规则，所有 AH2AC2 区间均按游戏进行聚类。 该集合中的分数选择（最低记录分数为 13；无出局）与其较高的总和（§ 3.1.2）一致；若将 hanab.live 语料库限制在相同或高于该最低分数的游戏中，则 338 局游戏会额外增加 +27.20 [ +26.29, +28.04 ] pp。

paragraphs.en: Ranking the cells of the shared taxonomy (§ 2.4 ) by the absolute difference between the human and level-5 gaps (Fig. 9 ) ignores how often each cell occurs. The split in § 3.1 is an accounting identity and assigns no cause. Its within-cell term weights each cell’s gap difference by the human share of plays. Its other term weights each cell’s share difference by the level-5 gap. The three largest differences are the two indirect-reference cells and a delayed color cell. Level 5’s gap is higher on three newest-card cells played right after a hint and, by small amounts, on three merged cells; the cells that are zero by construction close the list at exactly zero. The two indirect-reference cells are merged residual cells, which the next subsection resolves.
paragraphs.zh: 根据人类与第5级之间的差距的绝对差值对共享分类体系（§ 2.4）中的单元格进行排序（图9），忽略了每个单元格出现的频率。 § 3.1 中的划分是一种会计恒等式，并未归因于任何原因。 其单元格内项根据人类在游戏次数中所占的比例，对每个单元格的差距差异进行加权。 其另一项则根据第5级的差距，对每个单元格的份额差异进行加权。 差距最大的三个单元格是两种间接引用单元格和一个延迟颜色单元格。 在第3个最新卡片单元格（在提示后立即使用）中，第5级的差距更高；在三个合并单元格中差距也略高；而因构造设定而为零的单元格则使该列表以恰好零结束。 这两种间接引用单元格是合并后的残差单元格，下一小节将对此进行解决。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 ’s indirect-reference rows are merged cells, defined only by the partner’s preceding action, and their contents differ across populations (Fig. 10 ). The numbers in this paragraph use the frozen level-5 taxonomy on the full corpus, the basis of the right-hand panels of Fig. 10 ; on that basis the human color cell holds 238 238 plays. Decomposed by the played card’s own hint history, it is 81.1 % 81.1\% unhinted cards (the finesse configuration, + 63.9 ​ pp +63.9\,\text{pp} over 193 193 plays), 18.1 % 18.1\% color-known cards ( + 50.5 ​ pp +50.5\,\text{pp} ), and a remainder too small to estimate. The left-hand panels of Fig. 10 use a different basis, the shared taxonomy on estimation halves, whose residual cell is broader because it must be supported by all six populations; its unhinted share is therefore lower than the frozen-cell figure quoted here, and the two panels are not meant to match. Table 6 gives the reverse decomposition: all unhinted plays split by the partner’s preceding action. In human play, 286 286 of the 484 484 unhinted plays follow a hint to another card (gap + 57.9 ​ [ + 50.6 , + 62.7 ] ​ pp +57.9~[+50.6,+62.7]\,\text{pp} ), against 55 55 of 394 394 for level 5. On the remaining unhinted plays, humans and level 5 differ by + 5.3 ​ [ − 7.7 , + 17.1 ] ​ pp +5.3~[-7.7,+17.1]\,\text{pp} ; in AH2AC2, which keeps no struck-out games, the difference is + 9.5 ​ [ + 2.0 , + 16.8 ] ​ pp +9.5~[+2.0,+16.8]\,\text{pp} . The color-known sub-cell is the composition-matched comparison used in § 3.1.2 : + 50.4 ​ [ + 47.1 , + 53.6 ] ​ pp +50.4~[+47.1,+53.6]\,\text{pp} in AH2AC2 against + 50.5 ​ pp +50.5\,\text{pp} here.
paragraphs.zh: 表1中的间接引用行是合并单元格，仅由搭档的前一个行动定义，且其内容在不同群体中存在差异（图10）。 本段中的数字使用了针对完整语料库的固定第五级分类体系，这也是图10右侧面板的基础；据此，人类的颜色单元格包含238场游戏。 根据所出牌本身的提示历史进行分解，其中81.1%为无提示牌（精细操作配置，比193场游戏多63.9个百分点），18.1%为已知颜色牌（多50.5个百分点），其余部分过小无法估算。 图10左侧面板使用了不同的基础，即估算各半部分共享的分类体系，其剩余单元格范围更广，因为必须由全部六个群体共同支撑；因此，其无提示比例低于此处引用的固定单元格数据，两个面板也无需完全对应。 表6给出了反向分解：所有无提示游戏按搭档的前一个行动进行划分。 在人类对局中，484场无提示游戏中有286场遵循了对另一张牌的提示（差距为+57.9个百分点，区间为+50.6至+62.7个百分点），而第五级智能体中这一数字为394场中的55场。 在其余无提示游戏中，人类与第五级智能体的差异为+5.3个百分点（区间为-7.7至+17.1个百分点）；在AH2AC2中，由于未保留任何被排除的游戏，这一差异为+9.5个百分点（区间为+2.0至+16.8个百分点）。 已知颜色的子单元格是第3.1.2节中使用的成分匹配比较：在AH2AC2中为+50.4个百分点（区间为+47.1至+53.6个百分点），而此处为+50.5个百分点。

paragraphs.en: The corpus above reflects one set of collection and filtering choices. The AH2AC2 benchmark [ Dizdarević et al., 2025 ] independently released 1858 1858 two-player games collected from the same platform and convention community. The two collections share no game records: content identity over deck and full action sequence matches 0 0 of 1858 1858 against the raw hanab.live logs used here. This is therefore an independent collection from the same population (deck-level coincidences exist, but only because the platform deals seeded decks to many tables). Player overlap is unknowable, because the open data carry no player identifiers (§ E.6 ).
