paragraphs.en: The differences are consistent with AH2AC2’s selection rule (minimum score 13 13 , no strikeouts; mean score 23.45 23.45 against 18.52 18.52 for the hanab.live corpus). Excluding struck-out games removes games with three failed plays, which raises the aggregate gap mechanically. The rule also nearly eliminates unhinted plays (share 1.7 % 1.7\% against 5.4 % 5.4\% ) and tilts the indirect-reference cell toward color-known cards. On the sub-population the two corpora share, the cell replicates closely ( + 50.4 +50.4 against + 50.5 ​ pp +50.5\,\text{pp} on color-known cards). The category structure and the indirect-reference excess are therefore properties of the community’s play, not of how the hanab.live corpus was constructed. Population-level independence is a different question and stays open (§ 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 这些差异与 AH2AC2 的选择规则一致（最低分数为 13 13，无出局；平均分数为 23.45 23.45，而 hanab.live 语料库的平均分数为 18.52 18.52）。 排除出局的游戏会移除包含三次失败操作的游戏，这在计算上会人为地拉大总体差距。 该规则也几乎消除了无提示操作（占比为 1.7 % 1.7\%，而 hanab.live 语料库中为 5.4 % 5.4\%），并使间接引用单元格更倾向于颜色已知的卡牌。 在两个语料库共有的子群体中，该单元格的数值高度一致（+50.4 +50.4，而在颜色已知的卡牌中为 +50.5 ​ pp +50.5\,\text{pp}）。 因此，类别结构和间接引用超额现象是该群体游戏行为的特征，而非 hanab.live 语料库构建方式的结果。 群体层面的独立性则是另一个问题，目前尚无定论（§ 4）。

paragraphs.en: We freeze § 2.4 ’s level-5 machinery (discovery-half category definitions, category means and the fitted tree, verbatim) and apply it to human plays. The frozen tree explains R 2 = 0.28 R^{2}=0.28 of human per-play residual variance out of sample ( 0.37 0.37 using the frozen partition with human cell means), against 0.39 0.39 for a tree grown on human data itself and 0.12 0.12 for the hand-crafted map. Across the 26 26 frozen categories with at least 100 100 human plays, human and agent gaps correlate at r = 0.70 r=0.70 once the 6 6 categories that are zero for both sides by construction are excluded ( r = 0.81 r=0.81 with them), with human points on or above the diagonal (Fig. 11 b).
paragraphs.zh: 我们冻结 § 2.4 中的第 5 级机制（包括发现阶段的一半类别定义、类别均值以及拟合树，逐字照搬），并将其应用于人类的对局。 该冻结树能够解释人类每局对局残差方差中 28%（R² = 0.28）的样本外变异（若使用包含人类单元均值的冻结划分，则为 37%），而基于人类数据本身构建的树可解释 39% 的变异，手工设计的映射则仅能解释 12%。 在至少包含 100 局人类对局的 26 个冻结类别中，排除掉因构造原因在两侧均为零的 6 个类别后，人类与智能体之间的差距相关系数为 r = 0.70（若包含这 6 个类别，则相关系数为 r = 0.81），其中人类的得分点位于或高于对角线（图 11b）。

paragraphs.en: This transfer is consistent with the metric tracking play rather than how agent games are generated. It is not independent validation: a category’s gap cannot exceed its mean literal failure probability, and the same hint context can carry similar literal risk in both populations, so part of the correlation may reflect these bounds.
paragraphs.zh: 这种转移与对游戏过程的指标跟踪更为一致，而非智能体游戏的生成方式。 这并非独立的验证：某一类别的差距不能超过其平均字面失败概率，且相同的提示上下文在两个群体中都可能具有相似的字面风险，因此部分相关性可能反映了这些界限。

paragraphs.en: The gap moves little with how often a pair has played together within the corpus (§ E.5 ): near-strangers reach + 22.1 ​ [ + 17.8 , + 26.0 ] ​ pp +22.1~[+17.8,+26.0]\,\text{pp} , against + 1.22 ​ [ + 0.98 , + 1.45 ] ​ pp +1.22~[+0.98,+1.45]\,\text{pp} for level-1 cross-play, pooled over all pairings among five independently trained level-1 models [ Fukushima et al., 2026 ] . Both are zero-shot coordination, of opposite kinds. Level 1 is trained to read past actions only for their literal content, and its gap is similar in self-play and in cross-play. Human players appear to arrive already sharing a taught system. In point estimate, the self-play gaps of the OBL levels lie between the level-1 cross-play and near-stranger values, and level 5’s gap ( + 21.68 ​ pp +21.68\,\text{pp} ) lies inside the near-stranger interval.
paragraphs.zh: 在语料库中，智能体对共同游戏的频率对其差距影响甚微（§ E.5）：对于一级跨局游戏，近乎陌生智能体对的差距为 +22.1​ [ +17.8 , +26.0 ]​ pp +22.1~[+17.8,+26.0]\,\text{pp}，而智能体对则为 +1.22​ [ +0.98 , +1.45 ]​ pp +1.22~[+0.98,+1.45]\,\text{pp}；该结果综合了五个独立训练的一级模型之间所有配对的情况 [ Fukushima et al., 2026 ]。 两者均为零样本协调，但类型相反。 一级智能体仅被训练为读取过往行动的字面内容，其差距在自局游戏和跨局游戏中的表现相似。 人类玩家似乎一开始就共享着一种经过教导的系统。 根据点估计，OBL各级别的自局游戏差距介于一级跨局游戏与近乎陌生智能体对的值之间，而五级智能体的差距（+21.68​ pp +21.68\,\text{pp}）则位于近乎陌生智能体对的区间内。

paragraphs.en: On the 4 4 categories where the human value lies within the levels’ range, the agent profile saturates by level 2–3 and humans land at that plateau. Where humans diverge they exceed every level, the opposite pattern from limited recursion. A pre-registered cognitive-hierarchy fit leaves depth unidentified ( τ \tau ran to the grid edge in both models) and instead recovers a flat uplift of + 14.3 ​ [ + 13.2 , + 15.4 ] ​ pp +14.3~[+13.2,+15.4]\,\text{pp} on the categories where humans exceed every level (§ F.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在人类价值位于各层级范围内的 4 个类别中，智能体特征在 2–3 级时即达到饱和，而人类也处于这一平台期。 在人类出现分歧并超越所有层级的情况下，其模式与有限递归完全相反。 预先注册的认知层级拟合未能识别出深度（τ 在两个模型中均延伸至网格边缘），反而在人类超越所有层级的类别中恢复出一个 +14.3​ [ +13.2 , +15.4 ] ​ pp 的平坦上升值（§ F.3）。

paragraphs.en: This fit asks a simple question: can the human category profile be written as a mixture of the five level profiles, with the mixing weights set by a single depth parameter τ \tau (how many steps of reasoning a typical human uses)? If depth were what separates humans from the OBL hierarchy, the fit would return a well-identified τ \tau and no residual. The outcome is that τ \tau is not identified (it runs to the edge of its grid) and that a flat uplift on the above-every-level categories fits the data instead.
paragraphs.zh: 这种拟合提出了一个简单的问题：人类类别的轮廓是否可以表示为五个层级轮廓的混合，其中混合权重由单一深度参数 τ \tau（即典型人类使用的推理步骤数）决定？ 如果深度是区分人类与 OBL 层级结构的关键，那么拟合将能明确识别出 τ \tau 且没有残差。 结果发现，τ \tau 无法被明确识别（其值会达到网格的边界），而一个覆盖所有层级之上的平坦提升反而能更好地拟合数据。

paragraphs.en: The specification was fixed before the fit:
paragraphs.zh: 该规范在拟合前已确定：

paragraphs.en: M1 regresses the human category gaps on a truncated-Poisson ( τ ) (\tau) mixture of the five level profiles (pmf renormalized on k ∈ { 1 , … , 5 } k\in\{1,\dots,5\} ).
paragraphs.zh: M1 将人类类别差异对五个层级配置文件（概率质量函数在 k ∈ {1, …, 5} 上重新归一化）的截断泊松（τ）(\tau) 混合模型进行回归。

paragraphs.en: M2 adds a flat uplift β \beta on the above-every-level categories.
paragraphs.zh: M2 为所有高于该级别的类别增加一个固定的提升值 β。

paragraphs.en: Weights are inverse bootstrap variances of the human gaps.
paragraphs.zh: 权重是人类差异的逆自助方差。

paragraphs.en: Fitting : τ \tau by grid search over [ 0.05 , 8 ] [0.05,8] at step 0.01 0.01 , with β \beta in closed form given τ \tau .
paragraphs.zh: 拟合：在步骤 0.01 时，通过遍历 [0.05, 8] 区间对 τ 进行网格搜索，其中 β 的闭式解由 τ 给出。

paragraphs.en: Uncertainty : a joint bootstrap ( 2000 2000 draws, recorded seeds) resampling all six corpora and refitting both models per draw.
paragraphs.zh: 不确定性：联合自助法（2000次抽样，记录种子值）对全部六个语料库进行重采样，并在每次抽样中重新拟合两个模型。

paragraphs.en: Pre-registered truncation flags : τ ^ \hat{\tau} at the grid edge, and Poisson weight on level 5 above 0.4 0.4 at τ ^ \hat{\tau} .
paragraphs.zh: 预注册的截断标志：在网格边缘处为 τ ^ \hat{\tau}，以及在第 5 层上、τ ^ \hat{\tau} 处的泊松权重大于 0.4 0.4。

paragraphs.en: Both flags were raised. τ ^ \hat{\tau} ran to the grid edge in 2000 / 2000 2000/2000 draws under M1 and 1979 / 2000 1979/2000 under M2 (weight on level 5 at the edge: 0.48 0.48 ), so no depth estimate is quoted from the global fit; the reporting rule fixed in advance was to state this rather than to quote an edge value. What the fit identifies is the uplift: β = + 14.3 ​ [ + 13.2 , + 15.4 ] ​ pp \beta=+14.3~[+13.2,+15.4]\,\text{pp} , with wR 2 = 0.58 \text{wR}^{2}=0.58 (M2) against 0.10 0.10 (M1) and Δ ​ AICc = − 12.6 \Delta\text{AICc}=-12.6 in M2’s favor; the uplift explains 48% of weighted variance against 10% for the best cognitive-hierarchy component.
paragraphs.zh: 两面旗帜均已升起。在 M1 条件下，τ ^ \hat{\tau} 在 2000 / 2000 次（即 2000/2000）抽取中跑到了网格边缘；而在 M2 条件下，这一比例为 1979 / 2000（即 1979/2000）（边缘处第 5 层的权重为 0.48 0.48）。因此，全局拟合并未给出深度估计值；事先确定的报告规则是说明这一点，而不是引用某个边缘值。 拟合所识别的是提升量：β = + 14.3 ​ [ + 13.2 , + 15.4 ] ​ pp \beta=+14.3~[+13.2,+15.4]\,\text{pp}，其中 wR 2 = 0.58 \text{wR}^{2}=0.58（M2），而 M1 的对应值为 0.10 0.10；Δ ​ AICc = − 12.6 \Delta\text{AICc}=-12.6，表明 M2 更优。该提升量解释了 48% 的加权方差，而最佳认知层级成分仅能解释 10%。

paragraphs.en: Because the human corpus has pair structure the agent corpora lack, a sensitivity analysis outside the pre-registered specification clusters the human side by pair ( 95 95 pairs; recorded seeds) in both the nearest-level bootstrap and the fit (weights and joint bootstrap). Every category keeps its most likely nearest-level answer, and 15 15 rather than 16 16 categories pass the 0.87 0.87 threshold; the fit keeps the original set. Every qualitative conclusion of the fit is unchanged: τ ^ \hat{\tau} remains at the grid edge, the uplift term remains warranted, and the uplift moves to + 12.0 ​ [ + 10.5 , + 13.3 ] ​ pp +12.0~[+10.5,+13.3]\,\text{pp} and explains 34 % 34\% of weighted variance (M1/M2 weighted R 2 R^{2} 0.41 0.41 / 0.74 0.74 ). The β \beta point value and the variance split therefore depend on the weighting, and are always quoted with this sensitivity alongside.
paragraphs.zh: 由于人类语料库具有智能体语料所缺乏的成对结构，因此在预注册规范之外的敏感性分析中，将人类侧按成对方式聚类（95 对；已记录种子），并分别应用于最近邻层次自助法和拟合（权重与联合自助法）。 每个类别都保留其最可能的最近邻层次答案，且 15 个而非 16 个类别通过了 0.87 的阈值；拟合保留了原始集合。 拟合的所有定性结论均未改变：τ ^ \hat{\tau} 仍位于网格边缘，提升项仍然合理，且提升值变为 +12.0​ [ +10.5 , +13.3 ]​ pp +12.0~[+10.5,+13.3]\,\text{pp}，并解释了 34% 的加权方差（M1/M2 加权 R² 0.41 / 0.74）。 因此，β \beta 的点估计值与方差分解取决于权重设置，并在陈述时始终附带说明这种敏感性。

paragraphs.en: Two questions must be kept apart. Which single level is a category nearest to? is answered by the nearest-level bootstrap (§ F.2 ), category by category, and for 16 16 of them the answer is “above all of them.” What mixture of levels best reproduces the human profile? is the parametric question, and its depth parameter is unidentified globally because these categories exceed the entire basis: no mixture of levels reaches them, so the fit pushes τ \tau to the grid edge and the flags fire. The identified content of the exercise is the decomposition, a shared component saturating by level 2–3 plus an uplift no level supplies, together with the caveats that the basis truncates at level 5 and that each level is trained with beliefs induced by a fixed base policy (uniformly random at level 1, the previous level’s policy above it). The levels are therefore not literal cognitive-hierarchy levels.
paragraphs.zh: 两个问题必须保持区分。 “哪一个单一层级与某个类别最接近？”这一问题通过“最近层级引导方法”（§ F.2）逐类别回答，而对于其中 16 个类别，答案均为“高于所有层级”。而“哪种层级混合最能重现人类特征分布？”则是参数化问题，其深度参数无法全局确定，因为这些类别超出了整个基础框架：没有任何层级混合能够达到它们，因此拟合会将 τ \tau 推至网格边缘，并触发标志。 该练习的明确内容在于分解：一个共享组件在层级 2–3 处达到饱和，外加一个任何层级都无法提供的提升部分；同时需注意，基础框架在层级 5 处截断，且每个层级都是基于由固定基策略（层级 1 为均匀随机，高于该层级的则采用前一层的策略）所诱导的信念进行训练的。 因此，这些层级并非字面意义上的认知层级。

paragraphs.en: Behavioral game theory finds that people use one to three steps of recursive reasoning about others [ Stahl and Wilson, 1995 , Nagel, 1995 , Camerer et al., 2004 ] , which appears to conflict with a human gap above every level of a five-level hierarchy. Looking category by category removes the conflict (Fig. 12 ).
paragraphs.zh: 行为博弈论发现，人们对他人的递归推理仅使用一到三个步骤 [Stahl and Wilson, 1995, Nagel, 1995, Camerer et al., 2004]，这与人类在五层层级结构中每一层级之上的能力差距似乎存在冲突。 按类别逐一分析后，这种冲突便不复存在（图 12）。

sents.en: Looking category by category removes the conflict (Fig. 12 ).
sents.zh: 按类别逐一分析后，这种冲突便不复存在（图 12）。

paragraphs.en: On the three newest-card fresh-color categories (three of the 4 4 whose nearest level is 2 or 3), the agent profile saturates : level 2 already reaches +47 to +55 pp and levels 3–5 add almost nothing. Humans land at +51–+52 pp : at the level-2–3 value, and below the level-5 asymptote ( P ⁡ ( human < level 5 ) = P(\text{human}<\text{level 5})= 0.89–1.00).
paragraphs.zh: 在三个最新卡片的“新鲜颜色”类别中（属于4个类别中的3个，其最近级别为2或3），智能体分布已趋于饱和：级别2就已达到+47至+55 pp，而级别3至5几乎未带来任何额外提升。 人类的得分落在+51至+52 pp之间：处于级别2至3的数值范围内，且低于级别5的渐近线（P⁡(human < level 5) = P(\text{human}<\text{level 5})= 0.89–1.00）。

paragraphs.en: Where humans diverge they are above every level ( 16 16 of 20 20 non-zero categories), which is the opposite pattern from limited recursion. Those categories split into two shapes: profiles still rising at level 5, and flat-low profiles, including both indirect-reference categories, that stay low at every level.
paragraphs.zh: 在人类产生分歧的地方，它们处于所有层级之上（20个非零类别中的16个），这与有限递归的模式正好相反。 这些类别分为两种形态：一类是到第5层级仍在上升的分布模式，另一类则是平坦低值的分布模式，包括所有间接引用类别，它们在每个层级都保持低值。

paragraphs.en: Neither side needs to recurse at the table. The agents’ recursion is performed during training and folded into a deployed policy that acts without search; taught human conventions may be a community’s reasoning compiled into lookup rules over years. The gap describes the product , how far play departs from the literal prediction, not the process . High human values therefore do not contradict k k -level limits, which concern on-the-fly reasoning in novel situations.
paragraphs.zh: 双方都不需要在棋盘上进行递归。 智能体的递归在训练期间执行，并整合到部署的策略中，该策略无需搜索即可行动；所教授的人类惯例可能是一个社区多年积累并整理为查找规则的推理过程。 这一差距描述了乘积，即博弈与字面预测的偏离程度，而非其过程。 因此，人类的高价值并不与 k k 级限制相矛盾，后者涉及在新情境下的即时推理。

paragraphs.en: This appendix states how every number this paper computes can be regenerated.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录说明了本文计算的每一个数字如何被重新生成。

paragraphs.en: All posteriors are computed by the metric implementation released with the previous study [ Fukushima et al., 2026 ] , used at a pinned commit rather than as an installed package, so the joint posterior here is bit-identical to the previous study’s (verified play-for-play on the human corpus; Appendix E ).
paragraphs.zh: 所有后验概率均通过上一项研究 [ Fukushima et al., 2026 ] 中发布的指标实现计算得出，该实现以固定提交版本的形式使用，而非作为已安装的包。因此，此处的联合后验与上一项研究的完全一致（已在人类语料库上进行了逐字验证；参见附录 E）。

paragraphs.en: Every game entering any analysis, generated or observational, is replayed in the metric engine and required to reproduce its ground-truth final score exactly before any statistic is computed. This holds for the self-play and mixed-level conditions (§ 2 ), the seed sweep ( 35000 35000 games), every intervention condition and its baseline (Appendix D ), the human corpus, the AH2AC2 release ( 1858 / 1858 1858/1858 ), and every clone evaluation (§ H ). No condition reported in this paper has a replay mismatch.
paragraphs.zh: 每款进入任何分析（无论是生成性分析还是观察性分析）的游戏，都必须在指标引擎中重新运行，并且必须在计算任何统计数据之前精确重现其真实最终得分。 这一要求适用于自我对弈和混合水平条件（§ 2）、种子遍历（35000 35000 局游戏）、每个干预条件及其基线（附录 D）、人类语料库、AH2AC2 发布版本（1858 / 1858 1858/1858），以及每个克隆评估（§ H）。 本文报告的任何条件下均未出现重新运行结果不匹配的情况。

paragraphs.en: The OBL ladder values (§ 2.2 ) are quoted as reported in the previous study [ Fukushima et al., 2026 ] ; this paper’s recomputation from the same games gives the same point values, and some interval ends differ by hundredths of a percentage point. Each analysis emits audited entries (value, interval, source artifact path, recomputation script, clustering and seed) into versioned JSON files; a generator turns those entries into the numbers the manuscript prints, and the build fails if any printed number lacks an audited entry. Every entry records the pipeline artifact it was recomputed from, so any value this paper computes can be traced to per-play records without consulting the manuscript itself.

paragraphs.en: Environment seeds define disjoint blocks per condition; paired designs share their block with their baseline by construction. Analysis seeds (splits, bootstraps, fits) are recorded in the audit entries alongside draw counts. One documented exception to bit-level reproduction: the per-category bootstrap of § 2.4 keys its seed on the Python hash of the category label, so those intervals reproduce only up to bootstrap error rather than bit-for-bit; every other interval this paper computes reproduces exactly from its recorded seed.
paragraphs.zh: 环境种子为每个条件定义了互不重叠的区块；根据设计，配对方案与其基线方案共享同一区块。 分析种子（分割、自助法、拟合）会连同抽样的次数一起记录在审计条目中。 比特级复现存在一项已记录的例外：第 2.4 节中的每类别自助法，其种子以类别标签的 Python 哈希值为依据，因此这些区间仅能复现到自助法误差的精度，而非逐比特完全一致；本文计算的其他所有区间均能根据记录好的种子实现精确复现。

sents.en: One documented exception to bit-level reproduction: the per-category bootstrap of § 2.4 keys its seed on the Python hash of the category label, so those intervals reproduce only up to bootstrap error rather than bit-for-bit; every other interval this paper computes reproduces exactly from its recorded seed.

paragraphs.en: The analysis pipelines, the audit JSONs, the generated tables and figures, and the derived per-play records for the agent conditions will be released with the published version. The human and AH2AC2 corpora are redistributed only as derived, de-identified records consistent with their sources’ terms. Raw agent game logs stay on the generation server, because they derive from checkpoints licensed for non-commercial use; the included generation scripts regenerate them. The generation records name each checkpoint and environment seed but no code commit or checkpoint hash. The OBL commit and the hashes of all 25 25 checkpoints used here were read from the generation server in October 2026 and describe the files at that time. On that server, the unmasked intervention code path regenerated the level-5 baseline action for action ( 1000 / 1000 1000/1000 games; Appendix D ).

paragraphs.en: We trained clones of human play and of level-5 play identically, at matched data scale, with registered predictions. They reproduce the asymmetry of § 3.1 . The control clone preserves its source’s structure ( r = 0.967 r=0.967 at scale). The human clone reaches level 5’s gap on the dominant shared convention ( + 59.9 ​ [ + 58.0 , + 61.7 ] ​ pp +59.9~[+58.0,+61.7]\,\text{pp} ), while indirect reference and the unhinted newest-card cell collapse to − 5.7 ​ [ − 21.6 , + 12.9 ] -5.7~[-21.6,+12.9] and − 32.0 ​ [ − 37.6 , − 24.4 ] ​ pp -32.0~[-37.6,-24.4]\,\text{pp} (the latter below literal chance). Aggregate similarity to humans is not fidelity on the channels where humans differ from machines.
paragraphs.zh: 我们以匹配的数据规模和已注册的预测结果，对模拟人类玩法和模拟第五级玩法的智能体进行了相同的训练。 它们再现了 § 3.1 中的非对称性。 控制智能体保留了其来源的结构（在相同规模下，r = 0.967）。 人类智能体在主导共享惯例上达到了第五级智能体的差距（+59.9~[+58.0,+61.7] pp），而间接引用和无提示的新卡片单元格则分别降至 −5.7~[-21.6,+12.9] 和 −32.0~[-37.6,-24.4] pp（后者低于字面意义上的随机水平）。 与人类的总体相似性，并不反映在人类与机器存在差异的通道上的保真度。

paragraphs.en: The channels of § 3.1 matter beyond this paper because the field increasingly evaluates coordination agents against behaviorally-cloned human proxies rather than people; AH2AC2’s own evaluation protocol rests on behavioral-cloning stand-ins for the community measured above [ Dizdarević et al., 2025 ] . Cloning imitates the distribution of human actions; whether it also reproduces the human gaps on indirect reference and on unhinted cards is what our instrument can test.
paragraphs.zh: § 3.1 中提到的渠道在本论文之外仍然具有重要意义，因为该领域越来越倾向于用行为克隆的人类代理来评估协调智能体，而不是直接评估人类；AH2AC2 自身的评估协议正是基于对上文所测社区的行为克隆替身 [ Dizdarević et al., 2025 ]。 克隆技术模仿了人类行为的分布；而它是否也再现了人类在间接指代和无提示卡片任务中的差异，正是我们的工具能够检验的问题。

paragraphs.en: We train a clone of human play (HC: the AH2AC2 open games, 1,700 1{,}700 training / 158 158 held out; the hanab.live corpus, the human reference below, is not used for training) and, as the control, a clone of level-5 self-play (OC). Both use identical architecture, hyperparameters, data size and training steps: the OBL codebase’s encoder and policy network, trained by supervised learning only, and one frozen configuration for every clone. If OC preserves its source’s convention structure while HC loses the human-specific cells, the loss is cell-specific rather than an artifact of data scale. An OC series at 1858 1858 , 5,000 5{,}000 and 20,000 20{,}000 games calibrates what cloning captures at each scale. Four predictions were registered, with timestamps, before any training: the level-5 clone keeps its source’s profile and fresh-color gap; the human clone keeps the fresh-color conventions but not the indirect-reference and unhinted cells; preservation improves with data; and the human clone is less coherent in self-play than the level-5 clone. Clones are measured with the full ground-truth pipeline of § 2 : exact posteriors, replay verification, the frozen taxonomy. Because matched-scale clones are not coherent in self-play (HC: 100.0 % 100.0\% zero-score games; OC: 97.2 % 97.2\% ), their channel numbers come from a frozen-partner variant (clone fixed in seat 0 against level 5, 500 500 games, clone-side plays only, still fully ground-truthed).
paragraphs.zh: 我们训练了一个人类对弈的克隆体（HC：AH2AC2 开放游戏，1,700 个训练样本 / 158 个预留样本；hanab.live 语料库以及下文的人类参考数据未用于训练），并作为对照，训练了一个第 5 级自我对弈的克隆体（OC）。 两者均使用相同的架构、超参数、数据规模和训练步数：OBL 代码库的编码器和策略网络仅通过监督学习进行训练，且每个克隆体都采用一套固定的配置。 如果 OC 保留了其源模型的惯例结构，而 HC 失去了人类特有的单元，那么这种损失就是特定于单元的问题，而非数据规模造成的伪影。 在 1858、5,000 和 20,000 局游戏下运行的 OC 系列，校准了克隆过程在不同规模上能捕捉到的内容。 在任何训练开始前，我们记录了四个带有时间戳的预测结果：第 5 级克隆体保留了其源模型的特征和新颜色差异；人类克隆体保留了新颜色的惯例，但未保留间接引用和无提示单元；数据量越大，保留效果越好；且人类克隆体在自我对弈中的连贯性低于第 5 级克隆体。 克隆体的评估使用了 §2 中完整的真实标签流程：精确后验概率、重播验证以及固定的分类体系。 由于相同规模的克隆体在自我对弈中并不连贯（HC：100.0% 零分游戏；OC：97.2%），它们的通道数来自一个固定搭档的变体（克隆体固定在 0 号座位，对抗第 5 级对手，共 500 局游戏，仅记录克隆体一方的走法，但仍完全基于真实标签评估）。

paragraphs.en: At 20,000 20{,}000 games the level-5 clone reproduces its source: category-profile r = 0.967 r=0.967 against level 5, gap + 21.22 ​ [ + 20.87 , + 21.58 ] ​ pp +21.22~[+20.87,+21.58]\,\text{pp} (source: + 21.68 ​ [ + 21.34 , + 22.02 ] +21.68~[+21.34,+22.02] ), fresh-color cells within a point of the original ( + 56.9 ​ [ + 56.2 , + 57.6 ] +56.9~[+56.2,+57.6] vs + 56.8 ​ [ + 56.4 , + 57.2 ] ​ pp +56.8~[+56.4,+57.2]\,\text{pp} ). Preservation is monotone in data ( r = 0.842 / 0.916 / 0.967 r=0.842/0.916/0.967 across the series). The method, the architecture and the instrument are therefore all sufficient; what cloning captures is a question of what the data contain and how often.

sents.en: Preservation is monotone in data ( r = 0.842 / 0.916 / 0.967 r=0.842/0.916/0.967 across the series).
The method, the architecture and the instrument are therefore all sufficient; what cloning captures is a question of what the data contain and how often.
sents.zh: 因此，该方法、架构和工具都是充分的；克隆所捕捉到的内容取决于数据包含的信息及其出现频率。

paragraphs.en: At matched scale, the human clone reaches level 5’s gap on the dominant shared convention: in the level-5 category for an immediate play after a fresh color hint on the newest card, it reads + 59.9 ​ [ + 58.0 , + 61.7 ] ​ pp +59.9~[+58.0,+61.7]\,\text{pp} , against level 5’s + 56.8 ​ [ + 56.4 , + 57.2 ] ​ pp +56.8~[+56.4,+57.2]\,\text{pp} for the same category. The cells that separate humans from the OBL hierarchy do not survive cloning: indirect reference reads − 5.7 ​ [ − 21.6 , + 12.9 ] -5.7~[-21.6,+12.9] (color; humans + 61.3 ​ [ + 54.4 , + 66.0 ] +61.3~[+54.4,+66.0] ) and − 8.1 ​ [ − 19.0 , + 3.9 ] ​ pp -8.1~[-19.0,+3.9]\,\text{pp} (rank; humans + 41.1 ​ [ + 31.9 , + 48.8 ] +41.1~[+31.9,+48.8] ), and the unhinted cells read − 32.0 ​ [ − 37.6 , − 24.4 ] -32.0~[-37.6,-24.4] and − 17.6 ​ [ − 24.5 , − 9.6 ] ​ pp -17.6~[-24.5,-9.6]\,\text{pp} against the humans’ + 48.8 ​ [ + 38.4 , + 55.6 ] +48.8~[+38.4,+55.6] and + 43.2 ​ [ + 31.1 , + 51.5 ] +43.2~[+31.1,+51.5] . Every interval excludes the human value by tens of points. The control rules out the generic explanation: at the same data and configuration, OC preserves its source’s structure ( r = 0.929 r=0.929 with the frozen partner). What HC loses tracks how often a cell appears in training (each unhinted cell holds 0.7 0.7 – 1.1 % 1.1\% of AH2AC2 plays), not how large its gap is.

sents.en: At matched scale, the human clone reaches level 5’s gap on the dominant shared convention: in the level-5 category for an immediate play after a fresh color hint on the newest card, it reads + 59.9 ​ [ + 58.0 , + 61.7 ] ​ pp +59.9~[+58.0,+61.7]\,\text{pp} , against level 5’s + 56.8 ​ [ + 56.4 , + 57.2 ] ​ pp +56.8~[+56.4,+57.2]\,\text{pp} for the same category.
sents.zh: 在匹配规模下，人类克隆体在主导共享惯例上达到了第 5 级的差距：对于最新卡片上新颜色提示后立即出牌的第 5 级类别，其读数为 +59.9​ [ +58.0 , +61.7 ]​ pp +59.9~[+58.0,+61.7]\,\text{pp}，而第 5 级在同一类别中的读数为 +56.8​ [ +56.4 , +57.2 ]​ pp +56.8~[+56.4,+57.2]\,\text{pp}。

sents.en: Every interval excludes the human value by tens of points.
sents.zh: 每个区间都相差数十个点，完全排除了人类值。

sents.en: The control rules out the generic explanation: at the same data and configuration, OC preserves its source’s structure ( r = 0.929 r=0.929 with the frozen partner).
sents.zh: 控制规则排除了通用解释：在相同数据和配置下，OC 保留了其源结构（与冻结的搭档相比，r = 0.929 r=0.929）。

sents.en: What HC loses tracks how often a cell appears in training (each unhinted cell holds 0.7 0.7 – 1.1 % 1.1\% of AH2AC2 plays), not how large its gap is.
sents.zh: HC 所失去的，是某个单元格在训练中出现频率的追踪（每个未提示的单元格占 AH2AC2 出牌次数的 0.7–1.1% 1.1\%），而非其差距的大小。

paragraphs.en: On the frozen-partner runs, the clone’s unhinted newest-card plays are worse than literal chance ( − 32.0 ​ [ − 37.6 , − 24.4 ] ​ pp -32.0~[-37.6,-24.4]\,\text{pp} ; failure rate 95.5 % 95.5\% ), as are level 1’s in self-play ( − 13.9 ​ [ − 17.6 , − 9.9 ] ​ pp -13.9~[-17.6,-9.9]\,\text{pp} ). The clone’s value rests on few plays. A negative value here is consistent with a partner whose hints favor playable cards: the cards it leaves untouched are then less likely to be playable than the literal observer assumes. The partner alone does not account for the human clone’s value: with the same partner, the matched-scale level-5 clone reads + 2.6 ​ [ − 11.2 , + 16.7 ] ​ pp +2.6~[-11.2,+16.7]\,\text{pp} on this cell. Cloning reproduces the act of playing an unhinted card, not the situations in which humans make that play; one reading is that imitating surface behavior without the representation behind it is costly rather than neutral.
paragraphs.zh: 在“冻结搭档”对局中，克隆体未经提示的最新出牌表现比纯粹随机还要差（−32.0 [−37.6, −24.4] pp；失败率 95.5%），而其在自对局中的表现也是如此（−13.9 [−17.6, −9.9] pp）。 克隆体的价值仅依赖于少数几次出牌。 此处的负值与一个提示偏好可玩卡牌的搭档相符：它未触碰的卡牌，其可玩性则低于纯粹观察者所假设的水平。 仅凭搭档本身无法解释人类克隆体的价值：在与同一搭档的对局中，匹配规模的5级克隆体在该单元格上的读数为 +2.6 [−11.2, +16.7] pp。 克隆过程复现的是打出未经提示卡牌这一行为，而非人类做出该出牌决策的情境；一种解读是，模仿表层行为却缺乏其背后的表征机制，会带来代价，而非中性结果。

sents.en: The clone’s value rests on few plays.
sents.zh: 克隆体的价值仅依赖于少数几次出牌。

sents.en: A negative value here is consistent with a partner whose hints favor playable cards: the cards it leaves untouched are then less likely to be playable than the literal observer assumes.
sents.zh: 此处的负值与一个提示偏好可玩卡牌的搭档相符：它未触碰的卡牌，其可玩性则低于纯粹观察者所假设的水平。

sents.en: The partner alone does not account for the human clone’s value: with the same partner, the matched-scale level-5 clone reads + 2.6 ​ [ − 11.2 , + 16.7 ] ​ pp +2.6~[-11.2,+16.7]\,\text{pp} on this cell.
sents.zh: 仅凭搭档本身无法解释人类克隆体的价值：在与同一搭档的对局中，匹配规模的5级克隆体在该单元格上的读数为 +2.6 [−11.2, +16.7] pp。

sents.en: Cloning reproduces the act of playing an unhinted card, not the situations in which humans make that play; one reading is that imitating surface behavior without the representation behind it is costly rather than neutral.
sents.zh: 克隆过程复现的是打出未经提示卡牌这一行为，而非人类做出该出牌决策的情境；一种解读是，模仿表层行为却缺乏其背后的表征机制，会带来代价，而非中性结果。

paragraphs.en: This measures plain behavioral cloning at open-split scale ( 1,700 1{,}700 – 18,300 18{,}300 games, default configuration, no reinforcement learning). The deployed AH2AC2 proxies, cloned from 147,621 147{,}621 closed games and refined with regularized self-play, are not measured here. The scaling series warns against reading absence as impossibility: structure preservation improves with data, so channel survival at 10 5 10^{5} games is not ruled out. These results suggest that the shared, frequent conventions and the rare channels respond to imitation differently, so a proxy that matches human play on the former can differ from humans on the channels where humans differ from machines. Aggregate similarity is not channel fidelity: the same dissociation, at the level of evaluation methodology, that § 3.3 found at the level of the metric.
paragraphs.zh: 这衡量了开放分裂规模下的纯行为克隆（1,700 – 18,300 局游戏，默认配置，无强化学习）。 已部署的 AH2AC2 代理是从 147,621 局封闭游戏中克隆并通过正则化自我对弈优化的，此处未对其进行评估。 该扩展系列警示我们，不能将“缺失”等同于“不可能”：随着数据量的增加，结构保留能力会提升，因此在 10^5 局游戏中，通道的存在性并未被排除。 这些结果表明，共享的常见惯例与稀有的通道对模仿的反应不同，因此，在匹配人类常见惯例方面表现一致的代理，可能在人类与机器存在差异的通道上与人类有所不同。 总体相似性并不等同于通道保真度：这与 §3.3 在评估方法层面发现的分离现象，在指标层面同样存在。
